	Diluted FPO ---> New offer of Shares increases the outstanding shares of the company. 
	
		New set of shares are issued to the public through diluted FPO to raise the capital for funding new projects and activities of for paying debts. 
		
	
	Non-Diluted FPO -> Existing shareholders of the company sell their stocks to the public. 
	
		a.k.a Secondary market offerings. 
		
		Do not benefit the company in terms of raising more capital as these are generally issued to change the shareholding ownership pattern.

	Wet Bulb Temperature :--> To measure Heat and Humidity ----> By using a thermometer with the bulb wrapped in wet muslin. 
	
		Rate of evaporation and the temp diff b/w the dry and wet bulb depends on the humidity of the air. 
		
		Evaporation from the wet muslin is reduced when air contains more water vapor. 
		
		It is always between Dry Bulb temperature and the Dew Point. 
	
		Is is the lowest temperature to which air can be cooled by the evaporation of water into the air. 
		
		Measured by factoring in heat and humidity levels. 
		
		Higest point - 35 degrees celcius ====> Humans can no longer lose internal body heat by sweating and cool themselves. 
		
		Could potentially leads to heatstroke.

	Geostrophic Winds : Horizontal wind in the upper atmosphere that moves parallel to isobars. 
	
		Result from a balance between pressure gradient force and coriolis force.

	South Atlantic Anomoly -----> Near-Earth Region where the Earth's magnetic field is th weakest. 
	
		Area b/w Africa and South America. 
		
		Earth's Inner Van Allen radiation belt comes closest to Earth's surface, di[[ing doiwn to an altitiude of 200 kilometers. 
		
		Van Allen radiation belt- ---> Zone of energetic charged particles, most of which originate from the solar wind, that are captured by and held around a planet by that planet's magnetosphere. 
		
		
	
	Sunspot ---> Consists of dark region called Umbra ---> Surrounded by lighter region known as Penumbra. 
	
		- Areas where the magnetic field is about 2500 times stronger than Earth's, much higher than anywhere else on the sun. 
		
		- Because of the strong magnetic field, the magnetic pressure increases while the surrounding atmospheric pressure decreases. 
		
		- This lowers the temperature relative to its surrounding because the concentrated magnetic field inhibits the flow of hot, new gas form the Sun's interior to the surface. 
		
		- Therefor they are cooler than other parts of the sun.

	NAIRU ---> Rate of unemployment which is consistent with a constatnt rate of inflation. (Non-accelerating inflation rate of unemployement)
	
		At NAIRU---> The Upward and Downward forces on price(inflation) and Wage(unemployment) neutralise each other and there is no tendency for change in the rate of inflation. 
		
		NAIRU--> Dows not account for the variety of factors that impact unemployment, besides inflation. 

		If unemployement rate is lower than the NAIRU, the economy is operating at full capacity and there is upward pressure on inflation.

	Functional Redundancy ----> Species loss is compensated by other species contributing similarly to functioning. 
	
		Keystone species have low functional redundancey. 
		
		This measn that if the species were to disapperar, no other species will be able to fill its ecological niche. 
		
		The ecosystem would be forced to radically change, allowing new and possibly invasive species to populate the habitat and reducing its biodiversity. 
		
		Keystone mututalists are two or more species that engage in mutually beneficial interactions. 
		
		A change in one species will impact the other and change the entire ecosystem. 
		
		Keystone mututalis are of ten the pollinators, such as bees. 
		
		Pollinators often maintain gene flow and disprsal throughout widespread ecosystems.

			Article 94---> Each member of the UN, undertakes to comply with the deicion of the court in any case to which it is a party. 
			
		Judgements are final and without appeal.

	Ecological Amplitude : Every individual or species has a specific range to which it can tolerate ecological changes. ----> Known as ecological amplitudes. 
	
	Ecotype : Phenotype of an organism when it lives in a new environment for too long a time period. 
	
		(When an ecophene remains in its new habitat for too long, it becomes an ecotype).
		
		Therefor the adaptions are permanent and the genetic changes occur within the organism. 
		
		The genes they carry are responsible for the success in the new environment. 
		
	
	Ecophene ---> 1st response or phenotype an organis shows when it arrives in a new environment.  A morphologically changed phenotype.

	Dual Command System:
		o Under the dual command system, the District Magistrate and the Superintendent of Police (SP) share powers and responsibilities in a district.

		o Under this structure, the DM is entrusted with issuing arrest warrants, licenses while the SP has powers and responsibilities to investigate crime and make arrests.

		o The system is designed to ensure a lower concentration of power and making the police more accountable to the DM at the district level.

	• Commissionerate System:

		o Under the police commissionerate system, the powers of both policing and magistracy are concentrated with the commissioner, who is directly accountable to the state government and the
state police chief.
	
	
		o The commissioner of police under the commissionerate system exercises the powers and duties of a District Magistrate. The office also has magisterial powers, including those related to regulation, control, and licensing. These powers are also available to any officer under the commissioner who is not below the rank of an Assistant Commissioner of Police.

	Effect of Pollution on Plants 
	
		S02 ---> Necrosis (tissue death), blotching of broad-leaved plants and grasses, brownish discoloration of tips of pine needles, chlorosis(gradual yellowing)

		CO-----> Leaf-drop reduction in leaf size, premature aging, inhibition of cellular respiration

		Ethylene--> Dry sepal disease of orchids.

	Effect of Acid Rain : 
	
		Leaching of nutrients , making the soil infertile, due to the exchange b/w Hydrogen ions and nutrient cations like K and Mg. 
		
		Increase in Ammonia ---> Decreases rate of decomposition----> Nitrate level also decreases. 
		
		Lekin, Impact on Indian soil is less--> Because Indian soil is mostly alkaline, with good buffering ability. 
		
		Reduces rate of photosynthesis. 
		
		Retards growth of crops such as pea, beans, radish, potato, spinach, broccoli and carrots. 
		
		Plant log, acidified soil me se cadmium absorb karne lagte hain, jis se plant khane walo ki maa chud jati hai. 
		
		Acid rain se fish log ke gamets mar jaate hain. 
		
		Plant leaves ke cuticles damage ho jaate hain, which reduces photosynthesis.

	Card on File TOkenisation ---> RBI
	
		Card details, during a transactions are replaced by a unique code. 
		
		Token is unique for a combination of card, token requesor and the device. 
		
		Customer can request for tokenisation of any type and number of cards. 
		
		Customers have the option to register theri card for a particular use case. 
		
		A card issuer can refuse tokenisation of a particular card . 
		
		Customers have the option to set and modify per transaction and daily transaction limits for tokenised card transactions.

	Wetland (Conservation and management) Rules, 2017 : 
	
		1) Marine water ke wo areas jinki depth at low tides does not exceed 6 meters. 
		
		2) Include any habitat where water is a key to the environment and its wildlife. 
		
		3) Swamps, Marshes, Billabongs, Lakes, Salt Marshes, Mudflats, Mangroves, Coral Reefs, Fens, Peat bogs or Bodies of Water ==) Natural or Man-made,  Perma or Temporary. 
		
		4) Inke andar ka pani can be- Static or flowing,  Brackish or Saline.    
		
		5) Betichod, wetlands underground bhi ho sakta hai. 
		
		6) Sala, Rice Paddies bhi count hota hai.

	Oceans ke 3 zones : 
	
		1) InfraLittoral Zone : Dominated by Algae and has depth of about 16.40 feet below the low water mark. 
		
		2) Circalittoral Zone : Dominated by sessile animals like Oyseters
		
		3) Subtidal Zone : Lowermost part of neritic Zone and below the ocean's intertidal zone. This zone is never exposed to the atmosphere. 	



	Corals : 
	
		1) 30 N and 30 S, ke beech ke clear tropical oceans me flourish karte hain. 
		
		2) Brightly lighted water ke 5-10 m neeche, best grow karte hain.      Suspended particles ki wajah se feeding me pareshani hoti hai. 
		
		3) Saline water me rehte hain (27%)
		
		4) Even though, 90m neeche bhi mil jaate hain, lekin, 10m neeche inki growth rate declines rapidly. 
		
		5) Rivers ke mouths par nahi milte. 
		
		6) 18 degrees se kam ke temp me inki maa chud jati hail. 
		
		7) Inke color aate hain, Zooxanthellae naam ke algae se, jo inke tissues ke beech rehti hai. 
		
		8) Kuch Alpha corals, khudko feed karsakte hain.

	Tropics me itni jyada diversity kyu hai : 
	
		1) Temperate regions ki tarah yaha frequent glaciations nahi hue, to tropical latitudes have remained relatively undisturbed for millions of years . 
		
			Is se, species diversification ke liye bohot sara time mil gaya hai. 
			
		
		2) Tropical environments less seasonal hote hain----> More constant and predictable. 
			
			Is se, niche specialisation promote hota hai, and lead to a greater species diversity. 
			
		
		3) Yaha jyada solar energy available hoti hai. 


		
			Colombia me 1400 species of birds milte hain. 
			
			New York(41 N) me, 105. 
			
			Greenland(71 N) me bas 56. 
			
			
			India me, 1200 species of birds milte hain. 
			
			South America ke tropical Amazonian Rain forest has the greatest biodiversity on earth : 
			
				40,000 species of plants,  3000 Fishes,  1300 Birds,  427 mammals, 427 amphibians, 378 reptiles and more than 1.25 lakh invertebrates. 		
		


	Biodiversity bachane ke liye : 

	Narrow utilitarian Argument : Human log ko, nature se countless direct economic benefits milte hain. 
	
	Broadly utilitarian Argument : Nature provides various ecosystem services and other intangible benefits. 
	
	Ethical argument : What we owe to millions of plants, animals and microbes species with whom we share this planet. 
	
		We have a moral duty to care for their well-being and pass our biological legacy in good order to future generations. 





	Ecosystem : Functional unit of nature---> Jaha par, living organism interact karte hain, aapas me or surrounding physical environment se. 
	
		- Earth ke sab local ecosystems ko jod dene par jo bada global ecosystem banta hai use, Biosphere kehte hain. 

		- Ise study karne ke liye, do parts me divide kar dete hain --> Terrestrial(Forest, Grassland, Desert etc) and Aquatic(Lake, Pond, wetland, Estuary etc). 

		- Terrertrial Ecosystem : 
		
			1) Bas 29% of the golbe. 
			
			2) Ise 6 types me divide kiya jata hai. 

			3) Deciduous Forest       Deserts 		Grasslands		Taiga		Tropical Rainforests		Tundra
	
	
	
	Taiga : Arctic Circle ke south me Subarctic forest ka ek region padta hai, jise Tiga khete hain. 
	
		- Yaha, soil ke neeche Permafrost ki layers hoti hain, jis se soil marshy ban jati hai. 
		
		- Yaha, confirs ugte hain, jo slow growing and cold-resistant hote hain.  
	
	
	
	Tundra : Arctic circle ka treeless environment.
	
	
	
	
	
	
	Primary Productivity : Per unit area me koi given time me, kitna amount of Biomass ya Organic matter produce hua hai, by plants during photosynthesis. 
	
		- Weight (gm/m2) ya Energy(kcal/m2) me express karte hain---> Or, different ecosystems ki productivity naapne me kaam aata hai. 
		
		- Gross Primary Productivity : Rate of Production of organic Matter during photosynthesis. 
		
			Ye depend karti hai, plant species par, jo particular area me rehte hain. 
			
			Ye environmental factors par bhi depend karti hai, jaise ki nutrients and photosynthetic capacity of plants. 
		
		- Betichod, agar isme se, Respiration losses ko hata do, to Net Primary Productivity milti hai. 
		
			Ye, wo biomass hota hai, jo Heterotrophs(Herbivores and decomposers) ko available hota hai, consumption ke liye. 
	
	
		
	
		- Secondary Productivity : Rate of formation of new organic matter by consumers. 
	
	
	
	
	Decomposers log--> Dead organic praanio ko , inorganic Substances me convert kar dete hain. 
	
		- Iske steps hote hain : Fragmentation, Leaching, Catabolism, Humification and Mineralisation. ---> Ye saare steps, simultaneously ho rahe hote hain. 
		
		
		Detritivores (Ex: Earthworms) :---> Breaks down, detritus into smaller particles. --> Yahi to hai, fragmentation. 
		
		Bacteria and Fungus log, detritus ko, simpler inorganic substances me degrade kar dete hain---> Yahi to hai, Catabolism. 
	
	
		Soil me decomposition ke time, Humification and Mineralisation hota hai. 
		
			Humification se, Humus naam ka dark colored, amorphous substance banta hai, jo microbial action ke highly resistant hota hai. 
			
			Humus, bohot slowly decompose hota hai. 
			
			Colloidal hone ki wajah se---> Serves as a reservoir of nutrients. 
			
		
		Humus ko kuch chutiye microbes, further degrade kar dete hain----> Is se inorganic nutrients release hote hain ---> Yahi to hai, mineralisation. 
		
		
		Overall, decomposition is an oxygen-requiring process. 
		
		
		Decomposition slow ho jata hai, agar, detritus is rich in lignin and chitin. 
		
			
		Decomposition fast ho jata hai, agar, detritus is rich in nitrogen and water-soluble substances like sugars. 
	
	
		Warm and moist environment ==> Favour Decomposition 
		
		Low Temperature and Anaerobiosis ==> Inhibits decompositon ----> Resulting in buildup of organic materials. 
	
		
		Terrestrial ecosystems me----> Much larger fraction of energy flows throug detritus food chain than through Grazing food chain. 
	
		Aquatic ecosystems me --> Grazing food chain is the major conduit for energy flow. 
	
	
		Detritus bole to, dead organic matter. 
		
		Inhe saprotrophs bhi kehte hain.  Sapro bole to, 'To decompose'. 
		
		
		
	
	Plants ke succession ko 2 parts me classify kiya jata hai, based on the nature of the habitat :
	
		1) Hydrarch Succession : Wetter areas me 
		
		2) Xerarch Succession : Dry areas wala. 
		
		
		Lekin, both of them leads to medium water conditions(Mesic) -- Neither too dry(xeric) nor too wet(hydric)
		
		
		
	Paani me primary succession ---> Pioneers are the small Phytoplanktons----> Replaced with time by free-floating angiosperms---> Then by rooted hydrophytesm, sedges, grasses and finally the trees. 	
		 
		
		
	Rocks par Primary succession---> Pioneers are Lichens---> Secrete acids to dissolve rocks, helps in weatherin and soil formation.  	
		
		
	Succession chahe, land par ho, ya paani me, climax community dono me same hi banti hai---> the mesic. 
	
	Rock wala bas jyada tej hota hai pani wale se. 
	
		
		
	Primary Succession me jyada dikkat aati hai, kyunki ek to resources kam hote hain, or dusra saala, competition bohot jyada hota hai. 
	
	
	
	
	
	Alpha Diversity : Kisi particular area/ecosystem/community me, Number of Taxa(usually species) ko count karke measure karte hain. 
	
	Beta Diversity : 2 adjacent ecosystems ke beech jo species diversity hoti hai ---> Obtained by comparing the number of species unique to each of the ecosystem. 
	
	Gamma Diversity : Diversity of the habitats over the total landscape or geographical area. 	
		
		
		
		
	Genetic Diversity : 2 species ke populations ke beech, ya fir, sala ek population ke individuals ke beech bhi. 
	
		- Genetic diversity bachati hai, organisms and ecosystems ko after change has occured. 
		
	Species Diversity : Measure of diversity within an ecological community : Species Richness + Evenness of Species' abundance. 
	
		- Equitorial regions me jyada species richness hoti hai. 
		
		- Land ecosystem me, altitude ke saath, biodiversity kam hoti rehti hai
		
		
		
		
	Earth par species ka composition : 
	
		1) 70% se jyada recorded species to Animals hain. 
		
		2) Plants(including algae, fungi, bryophytes, gymnosperms and angiosperms) bas 22% hi hain. 
		
		3) Animals ke andar sabse species rich taxonomic group hai---> Insect log ka. ---> 70%. 
		
			Insect bole to 70 ka 70. 
			
			Har 10 janwaro me se, 7 insects hain. 
			
		
		4) Duniya me jitne Machhi, Amphibians, Reptiles and Mammals ke species hain (total), unse kahi jyada type ke fungus log milte hain. 		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
	
	Food Chain ka, Organism ki adaptability and competitiveness par koi effect nahi hota. Lekin, 
	
	Food Web---> Has an effect on improving the adaptibility and competitiveness of the organism	
		
		
		
	Sala, ek species, Ek hi ecosystem me, ek time par, 1 se jyada trophic levels ko occupy kar sakta hai. 
	
		- Ex : Ek sparrow , primary consumer hai jab wo seeds khata hai, or Secondary consumer hai, jab wo aadmi khane nikalta hai. 	
		
		
		
		
		
		
	Phytoplanktons 2 types ke hote hain : Chemosynthetic  and Photosynthetic
	
		- Chemo wale betichod, deep layers me rehte hain, jaha sunligh nahi pahonch paati. 
		
		- Dinoflagellates and Diatoms ---> 2 main types of phytoplanktons. 
		
		- Phytoplanktons can be bacteria, protists or single-celled plants. 
		
		
		
		
		
	Wildlife Sanctuary : 
	
		1) Human Activities allowed hoti hain. 
		
		2) Main aim hota hai, kisi particular flora or fauna ki gaand bachana 
		
		3) Koi fixed boundries nahi hoti . 
		
		4) General public yaha apni maa chudwane aa sakti hai---> open for all. 
		
		5) Formed by orders of central or state govs
		
		6) Can be upgraded to a National park
		
		
	
	National Park : 
	
		1) Yaha koi human activity nahi allowed hoti except the ones permitted by the Chief Wildlife Warden of the State under particular conditions. 
		
		2) Flora/fauna ya even, historical/Geographic significance wale objects ke liye bhi bana sakte hain. 
		
		3) Boundries are fixed and defined. 
		
		4) Public ko dikhte hi goli maar di jati hai. 
		
		5) Formed by State or Central Legislature. 
		
		6) Ise downgrade karke, Santuary nahi bana sakte

		Conservation International ke hisab se, 2 criterias hain, to qualify as a hotspot : 
		
			1) Region me kam se kam,0.5% or  1500 species of vascular plants hone chahiye---->Matlab, high degree of endemism
			
			2) Must contain 30%(or less) of its original habitat ---> Matlab, sala threatened hona chahiye
		
				(Matlab, 70% of its primary vegetation is gone)
		
		
		Initially 25 biodiversity Hotspots the, lekin abhi 36 hain total. 
		
			These are the regions of accelerated habitat loss.

	Duniya me jitna bhi carbon hai, uska 71% is dissolved in oceans. 
	
	- Blue Carbon : Carbon captured by world's oceans and coastal ecosystem. 
	
	Sea Grasses, Mangroves, Salt MArshes---> Stores carbon at much faster rate than other areas ---> Store them for millions of years. 
	
		(Isliye jab in areas ki maa chud ti hai, tab bhayanak amount of carbon is released)	
		
		
		
		
	Standing crop : Har trophic level par, ek certain mass of living material hote hain, jinhe standing crop kehte hain. 
	
		- Measured as the mass of living organisms(Biomass) or the Number in a unit area. 
		
		- Ek speices ke Biomass ko, dry and fresh ki terms me specify kiya jata hai.   Dry wala, jyada accurate hota hai.  	
		
		
		
	Pyramis of Biomass : Indicates the toal mass of organims at each trophic level. 
	
		- Ye usually, bottom par largest hota hai lekin hamesha nahi. 
		
		- Calculated by multiplying the number of individuals in the trophic level by average mass of one individual in a particular area. 
		
		- More accurate representation of energy contnet of 1 trophic level, as compared to Pyramid of numbers. 
		
		- Lekin, sala iske bhi limitations hain ": 
		
			Different species ke different breeding seasons hote hain.
			
			Or betichod, har janwar ka wajan lene tera baap jayega. 
			
		
		- Sea me, Pyramid of Biomass inverted hota hai(generally), kyunki, biomass of fishes far exceeds that of phytoplankton.          Terrestrial wale me upright, kyunki ped bohot bhari hota hai. 	
		
		
		
	Pyramid of Productivity : Looks at energy content as well as the Loss of energy between trophic levels. 
	
		- Ye baaki dono se jyada accurate hota hai. 
		
		- Lindeman's Ten Percent Law par based hai. ---> Only 10% of the energy in a trophic level will go towards creating biomass (Tissues, muscles, stems, leaves etc) in the next trophic level. 	
		
		- It is always upright. 
		
		
		
	Stratification : Species ke vertical distribution ko bolte hain, jo different levels occupy karti hain. 
	
		- Ex : Tree log, top vertical strata(Layer) of a forest ko occupy karte hain, jinke baad aate hain, shrubs, or bottom layers par hote hain, grasses and Herbs. 


	
	



	IgG : Immunoglobulin ---> Ek antibody hai. 
	
		- Hamari body, IgM and IgG antibodies produce karti hai, to fight against pathogens. 
		
		- IgM Antibodies : Pathogen ke body me enter karne 4-7 days baad ban ne lagti hain. 
		
		- IgG : 10-14 dino baad
		
			- IgG ke detect hone ke baad, ham confirm kar sakte hain ki banda was exposed to SARS-CoV-2.

	Guided Wave Testing (GWT)

		- Lekin, Meta-materials ki madad se, Guided ultrasound waves ka resolution badhaya ja sakta hai. 
		
			- Artificially created materials---> Unique Internal micro-structures---> Inse inhe wo properties mil jati hain, jo sali nature me bhi exist nahi karti.

	Non-Convertible Currency : 
	
		- Govt ke liye mushkil ho jata hai, international market me participate karna ----> Because these transactions generally take longer to execute. 
		
		- Stronger currencies, easily convert ho jati hain. 
		
		- Current account me, 1994 me Ruppe ko fully convertible kar diya gaya tha---> For Trading Activites, Remittances  and   Indivisibles. 
		
		- Lekin, Rupee abhi bhi, Capital account, non-convertible hai. 
		
			- Capital AC ---> Allows, freedom to convert local financial assets into foreign financial assets and vice-versa. 
			
			- Include free movement of --> Investment capital,  Dividends, Intersets, FDI ,  Trading of overseas equities by foreigners,  Foreign Remittances,   Sale/Purchase of immovable property
			
			
			
			
	Foreign Portfolio Investment (FPI)
	
		- Foreign desh ke financial assets me invest karna---> Ex : Stocks or Bonds available on exchanges. 
		
		- Can be sold off quickly---> Seen as short term attempt to make money. 
		
		- Ex : Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs),      Qualified Foreign Investors (QFI) and   Subaccounts etc. 
		
		- NRI investments, FPI ke under nahi aati. 
		
		
		
	
	2017 ke baad se, GoI ne FDI promote karne ke liye, ye sab steps liye hain : 
	
		1) 49% FDI permitted in insurance and Pension Funds (26% under automatic route)  and  Defence Sector

	REER : Real Effective Exchange Rate
	
		- Desh ki currency ka weighted average, in relation to an (index) or (basket of other major currencies).
		
		- Desh ke saath trade balance ke hisab se currency ko weights assign kiye jaate hain. 
		
		- Matlab, Avg of bilateral exchange rates between itself and its trading partnetrs and then weighing it using the trade allocation of each partner. 
		
		- Kisi desh ki Trade capabilites naapme me effective hota hai. 
		
	
	
	NEER : Nominal Effective exchange Rate 
	
		- Unadjusted weighted average rate at which one country's currency exchanges for a basket of multiple foreign currencies. 
		
		- NER is the amount of domestic currency needed to purchase foreign currency. 
		
		- Indicator of country's international competitiveness in terms of foreign exchange market. 
		
		- Forex traders refer to NEER as the trade-weighted currency index. 
		
		- May be adjusted to compensate for the inflation rate of home country relative to the inflation rate of its trading partners.

		- GATT ka 1st clause hai. 
		
		- WTO ke under bhi, koi member desh apne trade partners ke beech discriminate nahi kar sakte. 
		
		- Agar kisi desh ko special status diya hai to saare members ko dena hoga. 
		
			- Lekin, Free Trade agreements me engage kar sakte ho
			
			- Lekin, Members, developing countries ko special and differential treatments de sakte hainl

	Repo Rate : Funds ke shortfall hone par, RBI jis rate par commercial banks ko money lend karti hai. 
	
		- Ise hi Policy rate kehte hain. 
		
		- June 2010 me, 'Liquidity adjustment Facility" introduce ki thi---> Jisme the, Repo and Reverse Repo. 
		
		- RBI khali Repo Rate announce karti hai---> baaki, RR, Bank Rate and MSF, teeno, Repo se hi linked hote hain. 
		
		- RR---> Rate at which central bank of a country borrows money from commercial banks. 
		
		
		4 tarah ke Repos hote hain, maturity period ke basis par : 1) Overnight repos   2) Term Repos   3) Open maturity   4) Flexible Repos

		Monetary Policy Committee : RBI Act, 1934 ke section 45ZB ke hisab se bani hai. 
		
			- Frame monetary policy using tools like Repo Rates,  Reverse Repo Rate, Bank rate, Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR)
			
			- MSF,  Repo,  RR,  LAF

				3 ko GoI Appoint karti hai. 
				
				Lekin, koi Gov official nahi appoint ho sakta
				
			
			- Ise banaya gaya tha---> To bring, more transparency and accountability in fixing the Monetary Policy in India. 
			
			- Saal me kam se kam 4 baar meeting karte hain---> Har meeting ke baad, monetary policy publish ki jaati hai.

	Operation Twist : RBI's Simultaneous selling of Short-term securities and buying of Long-term securities through Open-Market Operation (OMO)
	
		- Short-term securities are transitioned into long-term securites
		
		- Taaki, long term-interest rates neeche laai ja sake and short-term rates ko badhaya ja sake. 
		
		- Bond prices and yields ke beech inverse relation hota hai. 
		
		- Jaise jaise, RBI, Long-term securities ko khareedta hai ---> Unki demand badhti hai----> Jis se unke price badh jate hain----> Or Yield neeche aa jati hai. 
		
		- Is se, log, long-term loans ko saste rates par le sakte hain---> Ex : Buying houses, Cars or Financing projects.

	Budget Deficit : Govt spending and Tax revenue ke beech jo annual shortfall hota hai. 
	
		- Annual amoun the government need to borrow. 
		
		- Effects : 
		
			1) National Debt badh jaati hai. 
			
			2) Jyada debt interest payments karni padti hai. 
			
			3) Currency ki value kam ho jati hai. 
			
			4) Currency circulation badh jata hai. 
			
			5) Aggregate Demand(AD) bhi badh jata hai . 
			
			6) Public Sector investment bhi shayad badh jati hai .
			
			7) Crowding out + Higher Bond Yields. 		
		
	
	
	
	Non-Tax Revenue :

		3) Petroleum license : Kisi region me exclusice right for exploration ke liye, jo fees di jati hai. 
		
		4) Power supply fees : Central Electricity Authority jo fee receive karti hai, from the supply of power under the Electricity (supply) Act.
		
		5) Fees for Communication Services : Telecom operators jo license fees dete hain, on account of spectrum usage charges

		7) Examination fees : UPSC + SSC exams wale

	Deficit Financing : Natinal Planning commission of India ne define kiya hai : 
	
		Gross National Expenditure me direct addition , through budget deficits (Revenue ya capital, kisi bhi account se ho sakta hai)
		
		- Gov, cover karti hai is deficit ko, by running down its accumulated balances  or   by borrowing from the banking system(manily from RBI)
		
		- To finance defence expenditrues during war
		
		- To lift the econom out of depression, so that income, employment, investment etc all rise. 
		
		- To diverst resources from unproductive sectors to productive sectors with the objective of increasing national income and hence higher economic growth. 
		
		
		
	
	Zero-Based Budgeting--> 1st time in 1986 in India. 
	
		- Sab expenses ko, naye periods ke liye, justify karna padta hai. 
		
		- Organization ke sab functions ko, unke needs and costs ke basis par analyze kiya jata hai. 
		
		- Iske baad, budget banate hain, around what is needed for the upcoming period. 
		
		- Iski madad se, Top-level strategic goals ko implement kiya ja sakta hai----> COsts can be measured against previous results and current expectations. 
		
		- Detail-oriented nature. 
		
		- Cost lower kar sakti hai. 
		
		- Lekin, time consuming process hai---> Takes much longer time than the traditional cost-based budgeting. 		
		
	
	
	Gender Budgeting : a.k.a Gender Responsive Budgeting---->  2001 Union budget me 1st time introduce hui thi. 
	
		- Globally followed practice----> Acknowledges the fiscal expenditure with a gender perspective and allocates funds for gender-specific outcomes to address the gender inequality . 
		
		- 2005 ke baad se, Union Gov--> releases, Gender Budgeting Statement consisting of 2 parts : 
		
			Women Specific Schemes--> 100% allocation is only for women. 
			
			Pro-Women Schemes ----> 30% allocation is earmarked for women. 
			
			
		- Schemes like---> MNREGA, Beti Bachao Beti padha,  Sukanya Samridhi Yojna   and  Ujjawala Yojna----> Women ki socio-economic conditions me kaafi improvement ki hai. 
		

	Outcome Based Budgeting : Practice of suggesting and listing of estimated outcomes of each programmes or schemes designed. 
	
		- Outcomes, ko bas Rupees ki terms me measure nahi kiya jata, but also in physical units like---> Kilowatt of energy produced or  tonnes of Steel produced. 
		
		- Outcomes are expressed in terms of Qualitative targets and achievements to make the techniques more comprehensive. 
		
		- Iske under, each Ministry presents a preliminary Outcome Budget to Finance Ministry, which is responsible for compiling them. 
		
		- Helps in : 
		
			1) Better Service Delivery
			
			2) Decision-Making
			
			3) Evaluating programme performance and Resuls
			
			4) Communicating Programme Goals
			
			5) Improving Programme effectiveness
			
			6) Make budgets cost effective
			
			7) Fix accountablity
			
			8) Aid better scheme management

	Commission for Agricultural Coasts and Prices(CACP_+) : Ye ek statutory Body hai.

	Trade Agreements : 
	
		1) Preferential Trade Agreements (PTAs) : 2 ya jyada partners---> Agree to reduce tariffs on agreed number of tariff lines. 
		
			- List of products, jinpar partners agree to reduce duty is called--> Positive list. 
			
			- Ex : India- MERCOSUR PTA
			
			- Generaly, PTSs do not cover cover, substantially all trade. 
			
		
		2) FTAs : Substantial bilateral trade wale items par, tariffs eliminate kar diya jata hai. 
		
			- Each maintian individual tariff structure for non-members. 
			
			- Ex : India-Sri-Lanka FTA
			
			- PTA me ek positive list hoti hai, jispar duty kam ki jaati hai, lekin FTA me ek negative list hoti hai, jispar duty eliminate ki jati hai. 
			
			- Compared to PTA, FTAs---> Generally jyada ambitious hote hain, in coverage of tariff lines(Products) on which duty is to be reduced. 
			
			
		3) CECA and CEPA : Integrated package on goods, services and investments along with other areas including IPR, competition etc. 
		
			- Ex : India-Korea CEPA. 
			
			- Trade facilitation,  Customs cooperation,  Investment,  Competition, IPR etc
			
			
		4) Custom Union : Partner desh--> May decide to trade at zero duty among themselves---> But they maintain common tariffs against rest of the world. 
		
			- Ex : EU and South African Customs Union(SACU) : South Africa,   Lesotho,   Namibia,  Botswana  and  Swaziland. 
			
		
		5) Common Market : Customs Union + Free movement of labour and Capital,  Harmonize tech standards across members, etc. 
		
			- Ex : EU
			
		
		6) Economic Union :  Common Market + Further harmonization of fiscal/monetary policies and shared executive, judicial and legislative institutions. 
		
			- Ex : EU				
	
	
	Primary Acitivies wale : Red collar
	
	Secondary Activities wale : Blue Collar
	
	
	Masala Bond : Rupee-denominated bond, jiski madad se, Indian entities, foreign markets me, Rupee me paisa utha sakte hain, not in foreign currency. 
	
		- Rupee me bonds issue karne se---> Indian Entity is protected against the risk of currency fluctuation
		
		- Also helps in internationalisation of rupee   and  expansion of Indian bond market. 
		
		- Ye bond, generally foreign exchanges, jaise LSE par trade hote hain, India me nahi. 
		
		- HDFC---> 1st Indian Company to issue masala Bonds. 
		
		- RBI ne---> Masala Bonds ko, total debt investment limit ke ambit se hatake, corporate bond investment limit ko badha diya hai.

		- Public Debt Management Agency(PDMA) banane se pehel ka ek interim arrangement hai.

	Sovereign Gold Bond Scheme : SGBs, G-Secs hote hain, but denominated in gms of Gold. ----> Substitutes hain, for holding physical gold. 
	
		- Investors ko, cash me issue price pay karna hota hai
		
		- Maturity hone par, Bonds will be redeemed in cash. 
		
		- RBI issue karti hai in bonds ko, on behalf of GoI. 
		
		- Redemption ke time, bande ko, ongoing market price of gold par rokda milta hai. 
		
		- No risk + Cost of storage of Gold. 
		
		- Market price kam hua to loss hoga, lekin, Investor does not lose in terms of the units of gold which he has paid for. 
		
		- Persons resident in India (As defined under FEMA act, 1999) are eligible to invest in SGB. 		











	
	Colonial Agri and Trade : 
	
	
		- Agri productivity ki maa chud gayi thi, lekin, absolute terms me is sector me growth hui thi. --> Kyunki, naye land revenue systems ke chakkar me aggregate AUC bhi badh gaya tha.

			 - Used to make payments for the expenses incurreed by an office setup by the Colonial GOv in britain,   Expenses on war,  Import of invisible items   ----> Kull milake drain of wealth. 
			 
		- Agri me us time me, 70-75% workforce lagi hui thi.    Mfg me 10% or baaki 15-20 % the, service sector me.

		- Shuru me bas, wheat ugane walo ko fayda hua. 
		
		- 2nd phase me : mid 1970s to mid 1980s ---> HYV tech spread to more states and benefited more variety of crops. 




	Foreign Investors ko lag raha hai ki, India ke future growth prospects ache hain----> So they start investing in Indian Bonds. ----> Will yield a high rate of return. 
	
		- Ye log, in bonds ko foreign currency me khareedenge. 
		
		- Jo banda, in bonds ko bechega, in foreigners ko, wo dollar ghar to le aayega, lekin sala dollar ke badle me, India me thodi kuch bechega ise. 
		
		- Isliye, wo jaake ise rupee me convert karega. 
		
		- Matlab, Money supply increase karega. ----> Matlab, saala Inflation le aayega. 

		- Isliye, RBI intervene karti hai, with its instruments to prevent this. 
		
		- RBI, G-Secs ki Open-marker-Sale karwayega (Jitna FOreign exchange inflow hua, utne ke amount ke barabar ke securities bechega). 
		
			Keeping the Stock of High Powered Money and Total Money Supply unchanged. 
			
			Thus, it STERILISES the economy, against adverse external shocks. 
			
	
	
	RBI ka balance Sheet : 
	
		Assets 										Liabilities	
		
		
		Gold											Currency
		
		Foreign Exchange									Public ke pass jo currency hai. 
		
		G-Secs											Commercial banks ke Vault me jitna cash pada hai. 
		
		Commercial Banks ko diye hue Loans							Commercial banks ne, RBI ke pass jo Deposits rakhe hain. 
		
													GoI ke treasury deposits. 
		
		
		



	Autonomous Transactions : Wo International Eco Transactions, jo, BoP ke independent ki jaati hain. 
	
		- BoP me inhe, 'Above the line items' dikhate hain. 
		
		- Jab, auto receitps, jyada ho, auto payments se, to BoP surplus me hai. 
		
	
	
	Accomodating Transactions : Inhe, 'below the line' itmes kehte hain. 
	
		- Official Reserve transactions. 
		
	
	Errors and Omissions : BoP ka teesra item (Current and Capital account ke alawa)
	
		- Balancing item---> Reflecting our inability to record all international transactions accurately. 



	BoP deficit---> Can be reduced by Depriciation
	
		- Depriciation hone par, hamare, exports, saste ho jate hain===> Brings more money in. 
		
		
		
		

	Capital Receipt : 
	
		- Main part hota hai---> Loans raised by the gov from the public---> Jinhe market borrowing kehte hain.  
		
		- Borrowing from the RBI
		
		- Borrowing from the Commercial banks and financial institutions----> Through sale of T-Bills
		
		- Loans recovered from the foreign govs and International Orgs. 
		
		- Central Gov ne jo pehle loans diye hain, unki recovery. 
		
		- Small savings (Post office , Savings account, National Saving certificate etc)
		
		- Provident funds
		
		- PSUs ke shares ki sale se jo net receripts aaye hain. 
		
		
	
	BC, Grant in Aids. Interests,   Investments par hue, Dividends and Profits etc, sab Revenue part me aate hain 
	
	
	
	
	Churning Poor : Regularly move in and out of poverty
	
		Ex : Small farmers and seasonal workers. 
		
	
	Occasionally poor : Rich most of the time, but may sometimes have a patch of bad luck. ----> Yahi hote hain, Transient poor. 
	
	
	
	

	Bank Rate : Official Interest Rate, jispar, RBI, Banking System(sab tarah ke-- Commercial, cooperative, dvpt banks etc) ko loans provide karti hai
		
		- RBI, buys or rediscounts bills of exchange or other commercial papers at Bank Rate
		
		- Also signlas the medium term stance of monetary policy. 
		
		- Iski madad se, RBI , commercial banks ko signal deti hai, of what the interest rates should be. 
		
		- Jab, Bank rate badhta hai, tab ye expected hota hai ki, baaki saare interest rates bhi badha diye jayenge. 
		
		- Ye repo se alag hai kyunki, ye long-term measure hai and is governed by long-term monetary policies of the RBI. 
	


	
	Fiscal Deficit : Total Expenditure - Revenue Receipts - Capital Receipts excluding borrowing
	
	
	Primary Deficit : Fiscal Deficit - Interest Payments
	
	
	Revenue Deficit : Total Revenue Expenditure - Total Revenue receipts 



	Revenue Expenditure kaafi bada hota hai, Capital Expenditure se. 
	
	
	Direct Taxes : 52%  > Indirect Taxes
	
		- Direct Taxes ka sabse bada hai---> Corporation Tax
		
	
	
	India ka GDP Ration ---> One of the lowest in the world. 
	
	
	
	GST : 101st Amendment Act
	
		- Ek destination based tax on consumption of Goods and Services 
		
		- State's share of taxes on Inter-State commerce goes to the one that is home to the final consumer, rather than to the exporting state. 
		
		- Products ke upar tax ka cascading effect bhi khatam ho jata hai. 
		
		
		
	
	Payment Banks : Nachiket Mor committee.
	
		- RBI ne bola hai ki, ye wale banks, 5 saal operation ke baad, Small Finance Banks (SFBs) me convert ho sakte hain. 
		
		- Aisa karne ke liye, Minimum Paid-up capital requirement hoga, Rs 200 crore. 
		
		- Rs 500 cr ki net worth reach karne ke baad, har Small FB should be listed. 
		
		
		
	
	NABARD : Identifies those RRBs, which require recapitalisation assistance to maintain the mandatory CRAR of 9% based on the CRAR position of RRBs. 
	
	
	
	Basel III : Basel Committee on Banking supervision ne, 2008 ki financial crisis ke baad, develop kiye the. 
	
	
	
			
	Leverage Ration : Ye financail measurement hai, jo pata lagata hai ki, kitna capital, debt ki form me aaya hai. 
	
		- Assesses the ability of a company to meet its financial obligations. 
		
		- Basel III me, jo leverage ratio indtroduce kiya gaya--> To reduce the risk of such periods of deleveraging in the future 
	
	
	
	CAR : Dividing the capital of the bank with aggregated risk-weighted assets for credit risk, market risk and operational risk. 
	
		- Regulated and watched over by RBI---> TO ensure that the Bank can absorb a reasonable amount of loss and complies with statutoru capital requirements. 
		
		- Jitna jyada CRAR---> The better it can fight moentary fluctations within an economy. 
		
		
		
	
	Money Market : Short Term---> Financial Assets, jinka period of maturity, 1 saal se kam ho
	
		T-Bills, Commercial Bills,  Commercial Papers,   Certificate of Deposit,    Trade Credit		

			
			1) Commercial Bills : a.k.a Trade Bills or Bills of Exchange---> Ek business firm, dusre business ko credit transaction ke time deti hai. 
			
				- Short term hote hain ye bhi--> Usually 90 days. 
		
				- Freely marketable hote hain T-Bills ki tarah, jinhe RBI issue karti hai.
				
				- Banks provide working capital finance to firms by purchasing the commercial bills at a discount. 
				
			
			
			2) Commercial Paper (CP) : Ise, Vaghul committee ki recommendation par, 1990 me introduce kiya gaya tha. 
			
				- Ye ek, unsecured promissory note hota hai, issued by a corportate with a net worth at least Rs 5 Crore,  to the banks for short term loans. 
				
				- Issued at discount on face value for a period of 14 days to 12 months. 
				
				- Issued in multiples of Rs 1 lakh subject to minimum of Rs 25 lakh. 
			
	
	Capital Market : Long Term : ---> 
	
		Shares,  Debentures,  Bonds,  Retained earnings,   Asset Securitization,   Euro Issues etc



	BC, ek sarkari Company bhi disinvestment me participate kar sakti hai. 
	
		- Sala, GoI LIC ko jabardasti bolit hai, PSUs ke shares khareedne ko. 
		
		
		

		
	Monetary aggregate : Formal way of accounting for money, such as cash or money market funds. 
	
		- Used to measue the money supply in a national economy. 
		
		- Circulation me kitna money supply hai + Commercial banks ne apne reserves me kitna store kar rakha hai. 
		
	
	
	Money Supply -> Public ke pass circulation me kitna hai.  ---> Printed Notes +  Money in deposited accouts + In form of other liquid assets. 
	
	
	M1 = CU + DD
	
	M2 = M1 + Saving depositis with Post Office Savings banks
	
	M3 = M1 + Net Time deposits of commercial banks
	
	M4 = M3 + Total desposits with Post office savings organisations (Excluding National savings Certificates)
	
	
		M1 and M2 ---> narrow Money
		
		M3 and M4----> broad Money	
		
		
	M3 ---> Most commonly used measure of money supply ----> a.k.a AGGREGATE MONETARY RESOURCES
	
		- Sum of all other classifications of Money (M0 + M1 + M2)   +   All of the less liquid components of the money supply. 
		
		- M3 ki madad se banks apne lending programmes run karte hain. 		
		
		
	
	Indian Currency System---> Converted to decimal system by---> Indina Coinage Act, 1955 
	
		- Rupee, Annas and Paisa were replaced by Rupees and Paisa System. 
		
		- 1 Rupee - 16 Annas,  1 Annas = 12 Paise		
		
		
		
		
	
	Legal Tender : Limited and Unlimited
	
		Limited : Coins
		
		Unlimited : Paper notes/Currency
		
		
		- RBI act of 1934---> Gives RBI the sole right to issue Bank notes
		
		- "Every bank note shall be legal tender at any place in India in payment for the amount expressed therein". 
		
		
		
		
	NABARD : B.Sivaraman committee ki recommendation par, 1982 ko banaya gaya tha---> Transfering the agri credit function of RBI   and  Refinance function of Agri Refi and Devp Corporation 
	
		- BC, ise, 100% GoI own karti hai. 
		
		- Goal --> To build a financially inclusive Rural India
		
		
		
	MCLR : Base Rate system ko replace kiya to determine the lending rates for the commercial banks. 
	
		- RBI ne 2016 me implement kiya tha. 
		
		- Ise determine karne me bank ye sab cheeze dhyan rakhta hai : 
		
			1) Marginal Cost of Funds : Marginal cost of borrowings and returns on net worth
			
			2) Operating Costs : Cost of raising funds 
			
			3) Negative carry on account of Cash Repo Rate (CRR) --> Matlab, RBI ke pass reserve maintian karne me kitna kharcha aata hai. 
			
			4) Tenor Premium : Higher rate of interest that the bank can charge for long-term loans. 
			
		
		- Ye fixed rate loans par apply nahi hota. --> Matlab, maine agar koi fix rate wala Car ya home loan le rakha hai to mujhpe MCLR nahi apply hoga. 
		
		- Bas banks hi MCLR follow karte hain---> NBFCs nahi karte
		
		- Gov Schemes ke under aane wale loans par bhi MCLR nahi laagu hota
		
		
		
	
	Scheduled Banks : RBI act, 1935 ke, Section 42(6)(a) me diye gaye criterias ko follow karne wale banks 
	
		- 2 primary facilites available hoti hain inhe : 
		
			1) Bank rate par, RBI se karja le sakte hain 
			
			2) Clearing house ki automatic membership mil jati hai. 
			
			
			
	Commercial Banks :Both scheduled and non-scheduled banks---> Regulated under, Banking Regulation Act, 1949. 
	
	
	Non-Scheduled banks par bhi, Cash Reserve requirements lagti hain----> But they are not required to keep them with RBI
	
		- They can keep these balances with themselves
		
		- They are not entitled to borrow from the RBI for normal banking purpose---> Par jab lode lage ho, tab katora leke aa sakte hain. 
		
		
		
	
	
	Payment Aggregator : Ek payment service provider hota hai, jo merchant log ko, register karta hai, using Merchant Identification number (MID)
	
		- E-commerce and mobile payment transactions process karne ke liye, through a single master account. 
		
		- Koi merchant,bina bank account setup kiye hi, credit ya debit card payments kar sakta hai. 
		
		
		- RBI regulate karta hai in Payment gateways ko, Ex : Paytm, PayU Bharat Bill etc
		
		
		
											
	Point of Sale Terminals par, Credit Cards nahi use kiye ja sakte. 
	
		- UPI , Debit Card allowed hai. 
		
		
		
	National Electronic Funds Transfer (NEFT)
	
		- Owned and Operated by RBI. 
		
		- Saal ke har din available hota hai. 
		
		- Near Real time me transfer ho jata hai fund. 
		
		- Sab type ke banks me, Pan-India coverage hoti hai. 
		
		- RBI, banks se koi charges bhi nahi leti. 
		
		- Online NEFT transactions par, customers ko bhi koi charges nahi lagte
		
		. NEFT ke through, Credit Card Payments,  Payment of Loan EMI,   Inward Foreing Exchange remittances etc. 
		
		- India to Nepal--> 1 way funds transfer bhi kar sakte hain.  		
		
		
	
	Peer-2-Peer Lending : RBI inhe special category of NBFCs samajhti hai or regulate karti hai. 
	
		- Ye traditional financial instis se, saste me loans provide kar sakte hain. 
		
		
		
	
	
	White Label ATMs : Wo ATMs jinhe, non-bank entities, own and operate karti hain. 
	
		- Banks ke customers ko banking services provide karti hain, based on the Cards(Debit/Credit) issued by the banks. 
		
		- 2012 me RBI ne permission di thi, non-bank entitites ko, ATMs setup karne ke liye. ---> Tier III to VI areas me ATM penetration badhane ke liye. 
		
		
		
		
	EXIM Bank : Export-Import bank : 1982 me GoI ne banaya tha----> 100% GoI Owned. 
	
		- Deferred Credit terms me, India se, Goods and Services, equipments, Infra Projects etc   import karwane ke liye, Overseas logo/instis/banks/govs  ko Credit dete hain. 
		
		- Inhone, BC-NEIA shuru kiya hai---> Buyer's Credit-National Export Insurance Account---> 2 way  tech transfer ko facilitate karne ke liye. 
		
		- This bank also issued, India's 1st US $ denominated Green Bonds. 
		
		
		
	Scheduled Cooperative banks : Kisi community ke members, ek dusre ko favourable terms par loans dete hain. 
	
		- Inke or Commercia banks ke beech 3 difference hote hain : 
		
			1) UCBs are only partly regulated by RBI----> Bas banking operation---> Capital Adequacy, Risk control,Lending norms etc
			
									Their Mgmt and Resolution in the cases of distress is regulated by the Registrar of Coop societies , under State or Central Gov
									
			
			2) They are not structured as joint stock companies---> Structrued as Co-ops with their members, carrying unlimited liability. 
			
			3) UCB ke borrowers hi shareholders ho sakte hain, aisa Commercial banks me allowed nahi hai. 
			
			
		
		- Inke Deposits bhi, DICGC cover karta hai, to a sum of Rs 1 lakh per depositor. 		
		
		
		
	
	
	
		
		
			
		
		
		
		
		
	Liberlisation se pehle ke haal : 
	
		1) Industrial licensing hoti thi---> Entrepreneur ko, sarkar se permission leni padti thi : To start a firm,   To close a firm,   to decide the amt of goods that could be produced
		
		2) Bohot saari industries me private sector allowed hi nahi tha. 
		
		3) Bohot saare Goods, bas, Small-Scale industries walo ko allowed tha. 
		
		4) Price fixation and Distribution par controls the. 
		
	
		Ye jyadatar restriction, 1991 wale reforms se gayab ho gayi. 
		
			- In sab cheezo ke alawa, sab Industrial license khatm kar diye gaye : 
			
				1) Daaru  2) Sutta  3) Khatarnak Chemicals   4) Industrial Explosives  5) Electronics   6) Aerospace   7) Drugs and Pharma
				
				
			- Aaj ke time me---> PSU ke liye, only industry jo reserved hai---> Defence equipment     Atomic Energy     and  Railway transport. 
			
			
			
	
	Financial Sectors me reforsm kiye gaye : RBI ko regulator of Financial sector ki jagah, as a Facilitator ki tarah hoga. 
				
	
	Lekin, 1991 me sabse pehla reforms kiya gaya tha, Foreign Exchange me : Rupee ko devalue kiya gaya, against foreign currencies. ----> Led to increase in Inflow of Foreign Exchange. 
	
		- Rupee value ke upar se Gov ka control bhi hatne ki shuruat ho gayi. 
		
		- Aajkal, jyadatar, market forces hi, determine karte hain. exchange rate. 

	
	Trade and Investment Policy Reforms bhi kiye gaye :   To increase the international competivtiveness of industrial production 
	
		- Also, to bring foreign Investment and tech into the economy. 
		
		- Local industries ki efficiency ko promote karna, or ki wo nayi tech ko adopt karein. 
		
		- Importa and Exporta par lage, quantitative restrictions ko hata liya gaya. ---> Puri Tarah se, from April 2001. 
		
		- Tariff rates ko kam kiya gaya. 
		
		- Importa ke liye, licensing procedures ko remove kiay gaya. 
		
		- Hazardous and Envtly sensitive industries ke alawa, baki sab cheez ke liye, import licensing bhi abolish kar diya.

	Price Floor : Kisi particular Good/Service ke liye, Gov imposed lower limit on price jo hoti hai.

	COral Bleaching ke reasons :

		2) Oxygen Starvation caused by increase in Zooplankton levels. 
		
		3) Increased Solar Irradiance
		
		4)Increased sedimentation
		
		5) Bacterial Infection
		
		6) Change in Salinity
		
		7) Herbicide
		
		8) Extreme low tide and exposure
		
		9) Sun-screen ingrediants like : Oxybenzone, Butylaraben,  Octylmethoxycinnamate,  Enzacamene

		- Is bhai ke time hi, Iqtadari system shuru hua tha. 
		
			1) Military commanders ko, as governors appoint kar diya jata tha on territories, called Iqtas.    
			
			2) Iqtas ke holders ko Iqtadars,  Muqtis  ya  WAlis kehte the. 
			
			3) Inka kaam tha, military campaigns lead karna or, Iqtas me law and order maintain karna
			
			4) Iqta se jo revenue collect hoti thi, wahi Muqti ki salary hoti thi. 
			
			5) Effective control ke liye, ye jaruri tha ki ye iqte, heriditary na ho jaye. Isliye, inhe transfer karte rehte the. 
			
			6) Alauddin or Muhammad Tughlaq, kaafi harshly transfer kar diya karte the.    Revenue collection ke liye, accountants bhi appoint karte the.

		- Higher and lower classes speak different languages.

		- Gupta period ---> Compliation of various smritis (law books written in verse)
		
		- Is period ke baad : In smritis par commentaries likhi jani bhi shuru ho gayi thi. 
		
		- Amarsimha ne, Amarkosa likhi ---> Ye, Sanskrit seekhne wale ladko ko padhai jaati thi.  
		
			- Ye bhai, CP-II ke court me tha. 
			
		- Kalidas ne, Abhijnanasakuntalam likhi. 
		
		- Bhasa ne 13 plays likhe. 
		
		- Gupta period me hi, early Puranas compile kiye gaye the. ---> Full of myths, Legends and sermons 
		
		- Gupta period me hi---> Development of Sanskrit Grammer, based on Panini and Patanjali.

	ARTs : Assisted reproductive Techs : 
	
		1) IVF : Most common---> 
		
			- Ande or Ras ko lab me combine kar dete hain. 
			
			- Fertilised egg ko, women ki uterus ke andar place kar dete hain----> "Embryo transfer". 
			
			- Mitochondrial Replacement Therapy(MRT) : 3-parent baby---> Ye ek tarah ka IVF hi hai. 
			
			
		2) GIFT : Gamete intrafallopain Transfer
		
			- Ande or Ras ko, lab me combine karte hain. 
			
			- Eggs ko fir, fallopian tubes me implant karte hain. 
			
			- Fertilisation happens inside woman's body. 
			
		3) Intrauterine insemination(IUI) : a.k.a Artificial insemination
		
			- Long narrow tube ki madad se, sperm ko, women ki uterus me insert kar dete hain, at or just before the time of ovulation
			
		4) Gestational Surrogacy : Embryo ko IVF se create karte hain, or fir, ise surrogate me transfer kar dete hain. 
		
			- Matlab, child is not biologically related to the surrogate mother
			
			- Surrogate mother ko, gestational carrier kehte hain. 			
	
	
	
	
	'Countdown to 2023' : WHO ki report hai---> Global trans-fat elimiation by 2023. 
	
		- Trans-Fats : a.k.a Partially Hydrogenated oils
		
			1) Liquid Vegetable oil par, hydrogen add karne se milte hain. 
			
			2) Is se, shelf life badh jati hai, and make them more suitable for frying and other uses. 
			
			3) Bad cholesterol(LDL) ko badhate hain, or good wale ko kam karte hain. 
			
			4) Good Cholesterol : High-Density lipoproteins ---> Pich up excess cholesterol and transport it back to body's liver for processing. 
			
			4) Bad Cholesterol : Ye, cholesterol ko puri body me transport karte hain---> Body ki arteries me bind up ho jata hai, reducing blood flow, increases chances of Heart attack and stroke. 
			
		- Matlab, veggie oil ko harden karne se Trans fats bante hain.  Jitna solid fat---> More trans fats it contains
		
		- NAturally occuring trans fats : Ruminants me milte hain, jaise cows and sheeps. 
		
		- Indsutrially produced : Hardened veggie fats such as margarine ---> Present in snack foods, baked goods and fried foods. 
		
		- India me har saal 60,000 log, inki wajah se marte hain. 
		
		- WHO ka REPLACE action framework==> Eliminate industrially produced trans fats from food supplies. ----> TOtal energy intake ke 1% se kam karna hai.

	Ballistic Missile : Jab, actual flight ke time, koi active propulsion na diya jaye. 
	
		- Sab tarah ke weapons fire kiye ja sakte hain. 
		
		- India ki Ballistic Missiles : Agni,  Prithvi  and  Dhanush
		
		
			International COde of Conduct against Ballistic Missile Proliferation(ICOC) ---> Hague Code of Conduct
			
				- India bhi signatory hai iska
				
		5500 km se jyada range ki Ballistic Missiles ko--> ICBMs kehte hain
		
					
		- Ye, atmosphere ke upar travel karti hain---> Experience very less drag,   Use Gravity  and  Earth's Rotation to cover very long distance
		
		- Ye, Highly fuel efficient hoti hain----> Only requirement are during lift-off phase and during course correction measures. 
		
		- Inki Payload carrying capacity---> Significantly more than cruise missiles. 	
		
		
		
		
		Cruise Missiles : Self-propelled till the end of the flight. 
		
			- Earth ke atmosphere ke andar
			
			- Small range--> 500 km se kam
			
			- Hits targets with high precision and it is constantly propelled
			
			- But, limited payload capacity
			
			- Primarily conventional warheads ke liye
			
			- Ex : BrahMos Missiles

	PDS or Mid-Day meal me milne wali saari rice ko, 2024 tak, Fortify kar diya jayega. 
	
		- Rice fortify karne ki techniques : Coating and Dusting .   Lekin India me : Extrusion naam ki tech best hai. 
		
		- Extrusion me, Dry rice flour ko, micronutrients or Paani ke premix ke saath mix kiya jata hai. ---> Ise fir, process karke, Fortified Rice kernels banaye jaate hain, jo rice jaise dikhte hain
		
		- Food Min. ki guidelines ke hisab se, 10gm FRK ko 1kg rice se blend karna hota hai.   FRK ki shelf life 12 mahine ki hoti hai. 
		
		- Rice kernels ko, IRon, FOlic Acid, Vitamin-B, Vitamin-A and Zinc jaise mincronutrients se fortify kiya ja sakta hai. 
		
		- FSSAI ne, 2016 me, 5 products ke liye, F+ logo diya tha 
		
			1) Fortified Rice and Wheat : Iron +  Vitamin B12  + Folic Acid
			
			2) Fortified Dudh and Edible Oil : Vitamin A and D
			
			3) Double FOrtified Salt : Iodine and Iron
			
		- 1 kilo fortification par Rs 0.60 kharcha aata hai ---> Ise Centre or State GOvs share karenge. 
		
		- Bio-Fortification alag cheez hai : Increase in nutrient levels in crops during plant growth rather than through means during processing of the crops. 
		
		
		
		- Lekin, Food fortification se : Hypervitaminosis ho sakta hai : High storage levels ko vitamins : Toxicity ho sakti hai.

	GoI ne, Montreal Protocol ke, Kigali Amendment ko approve kar diya hai.
	
		- Substances controlled by the protocol : 
		
			1) Annex A --> CFCs, Halons
			
			2) Annex B --> other fully halogenated CFCs,   Carbon tetrachloride,  Methyl Chloroform
			
			3) Annex C --> HCFCs
			
			4) Annex F --> HFCs or Hydrofluorocarbons
			
			
		- Ye sab Ozone layer ko maa kigali dete hain. 
		
		- Sabse pehle VIenna Convention hui thi---> 1985 me,   FIr Montreal Protocol Sign hua tha, 1987 me. 
		
		- 1990 me, Montreal parties ke liye---> Technological and Economic Assessment Panel establish kiya tha. 
		
		- India 1991 me, Vienna ka, or 1992 me Montral ka party bana. 
		
		- CFCs ka abhi bhi use hota tha----> Metered dose Inhalers me.---> Ise bhi 2012 me band kar diya gaya. 
		
		- Envt Ministry ne---> Ozone Cell banaya hai ---> As a Natioal Ozone Unit(NOU). 
		
		- 2016 me Kigali Amendment sign hua ----> Phase-down of HFCs is established.

		- Tera-ethyl Lead---> 1921 me iski, antiknock properties ka pata chala tha.

		- Petrol ke liiye----> Ocrance number(iso-octane par based),   Diesel ke liye---> Cetane number

	Atlantic Meridonial Overturning Circulation(AMOC)
	
		1) IPCC ke 6th report ke hisab se---> Ye sala decline hone wala hai. 
		
		2) Atlantic Ocean me----> Large system of Ocean currents hai. 
		
		3) Heats and Nutrients distribute karta hai. 
		
		4) Gulf of Mexico se----> North ki taraf, Ocean ke upper layers me--> Warm and Salty water leke jaata hai----> (Mexico ke pass- Gulf Stream   and   UK ke Pass - North Atlantic Current)
		
		5) High latitutes me ye paani thanda ho jata hai---> Or Sink ho jata hai---> Fir ye saal Tropics ke paas lot jat hai, as bottom current.
		
		6) Yaha se fir ye, Antarctic Circumpolar Current ki madad se, saare ocean basins me distribute ho jata hai. 
		
		7) YE Thermo-Haline circulaton hai---> Jise, Great Ocean Conveyor Belt bhi kehte hain. 
		
		
		
		
		
	Tipping Points : Tiny change se, pure system ki maa chud sakti hai.    Climate me aise 9 tipping points hain : 
	
		1) Amazon Rainforest---> Droughts aa rahe hain
		
		2) Arctic Sea Ice ---> Massive losses
		
		3) Artlantic Circulation ---> 1550s se slowdown ho raha hai	
		
		4) Boreal Forests---> Fires
		
		5) Coral Reefs ---> Mass Die-off
		
		6) Greenland ice-sheets ---> Ice loss accelerate ho raha hai. 
		
		7) Permafrost ---> MElt ho raha hai. 
		
		8) West Antarctic Ice sheet ---> Ice loss accelerate ho raha hai. 
		
		9) Wilkes Basin ----> East Antarctica ka ice bhi loss ho raha hai.

	IMF ka SDR : 
	
		1) Internation Reserve Asset hai, jise 1969 me banaya gaya tha----> To supplement member countrie's official reserves. 
		
		2) Iski value, 5 currencies par based hoti hai : US Dollar,  Euro,  Chinese Renminbi,   Japanese Yen   and  British Pound Sterling
		
		3) Ye na to koi currency hai, na hi ye koi claim hai, IMF par. 
		
		4) Lekin, ye potential claim hai, on the freely usable currencies of IMF members. 
		
		5) SDRs ko in currencies ke saath exchange kiya ja sakta hai. 
		
		6) Countires ke unke Quotas ke respectively, SDRs assign hoti hai. ---> Matlab voting power is directly proportional to SDRs.

	BCG Vaccine ke 100 saal pure ho gaye : Ye TB se ladne ki only licensed vaccine hai. 
	
		- Equator se jitna jyada door hote hain, utna hi jyada kaam aati hai.
		
		- Equator ke paas, environmental mycobacteria ki prevalence bohot jyada hoti hai, jo is vaccine se lode lete hain. 
		
		- BCG ko, respiratory and bacterial infections ke against bhi use kiya ja sakta hai, bacho ke case me. 
		
		- Leprosy or Buruli's ulcer jaise mycobacterial diseases me bhi kaam aati hai. 
		
		- Kuch type ke cancer ke liye , immunotherapy agent ka bhi kaam karta hai. 
		
		- India me TB ke 27% rogi rehte hain. 
		
		- India ne, 2025 tak, TB eliminate karne ka committment le rakha hai. 
		
		- VPM-1002 (ek recombinant BCG vaccine)   and    Mycobacterium indicus pranii,    naam ki 2 vaccine ke clinical trials chal rahe hain India me, by ICMR.

	Vaccine banane ke 3 tareeke : 
	
		1) Pura ka pura, Virus ya bacteria hi ghused do
		
			- Ise bhi 3 tarah se banaya ja sakta hai : 
			
				i) Inactivated vaccine(killing it with heat, chemicals etc)   
					
					- Flu  and  Polio vaccines is se banti hai. 
					
					- Virus or Bacteria grow karne ke liye special lab facilites chahiye hoti hai. ----> Long Production time. 
					
					- 2 ya 3 dose chahiye hoti hai, admin karne ke liye. 
				
			        ii) Live-Attenuated vaccine(jinda but weakend)
		
					- Measles,  Mumps or Rubella (MMR) vaccine ,    Chickenpox and shingles vaccine isi se banti hai. 
					
					- Compromised immune system walo ko ye vaccine maa chod sakti hai. 
					
					
			      iii) Viral Vector Vaccine : Safe virus ki madad se specific sub-parts , jaise ki proteins- of the germ of interest ko deliver karte hain
			      
			      		- Can trigger immune respone without causing disease
			      		
			      		- Ebola vaccine 
			      		
			      		- Ise, rapidly develop kiya ja sakta hai. 
			     		      		- 	
		
		
		2) Bas, Genetic Material ghusedo
		
		3) Bas unhi parts ko ghusedo, jo immune response trigger karte hain. 
		
		
		
			DNA and RNA ---> Nucleic Acid vaccines hote hain---> Gene-Based vaccines. 
			
				- Immune response se anti-bodies produce hoti hain---> Jo hame aage bachati hain. 
				
				- DNA pehle, Messanger RNA me convert hota hai----> Ye as a blueprint use hota hai----> To make specific protein, jo Human bodies ke andar ek immune response trigger karta hai. 
				
				- DNA vaccine me, DNA ka ek piece(encoding the antigen) ---> 1st inserted into a bacterial plasmid. 
				
				- Plasmid---> Ek chota sa, circular DNA molecule hota hai, jo Bacteria ya dusri cells me milta hai.  
				
				- Inme thode se hi genes hote hain, jo generally, koi antibiotic resistance se associated hote hain. 
				
				- DNA plasmids(jo antigen carry kar rahe hain)----> Ko muscles me inject kiya jata hai, jis se fir ye cells me chale jaate hain---> Using tech such as "Electroporation".
				
				- RNA vaccines se, Antigen of interest, mRNA me encode hota hai. 
				
				- RNA ko directly ghused sakte hain, ya fir,nanoparticles ke saath(Jaise Pfizer ki mRNA based Covid vaccine) 
				
				- mRNA ke ulat, DNA wali vaccines, ko ultra-cold storage systems nahi chahiye hote, or ye jyada cost effective bhi hoti hain. 
				
				
		Nucleic Acid Vaccines ke fayde : 
		
			1) Ye safe or non-infectious hoti hain, kyunki ye koi pathogen particles nahi hota. 
			
			2) Traditional vaccines se strong immune response
			
			3) Jyada rapidly produce kar sakte hain.

	ST and Other Traditional Forests Dwellers (Recognition of Forest rights) Act, 2006
	
		1) FDST  and  OTFDs ko individual and community forest rights diye hain. 
		
		2) Jis forest jameen pe wo kheti karte hain, wo unhe de di gayi hai---> Max 4 hectares.   Koi nayi jameen nahi di jaa rahi hai. 
		
		3) Minor Forest Produce, Grazing, Fishing ke bhi rights diye hain. 
		
		4) Bina rehab ke, Tribals ke eviction par rok. 
		
		5) Community Forest Resource ko protect, regenrate or conserve or manage karne ke right diye gaye hain. 
		
		6) Interllectual property rights bhi,   Recognition of traditional customary rights
		
		7) IFR(Individual) or CFR(Community) ke nature or Extent ko determine karne ka kaam--> Gram Sabha ko diya hai. 
		
		
		
		Act se define hua hai : 
		
			1) Community Forest Resource : Wo area(including reserved forests, Protected forests, Sanctuaries or National  Parks), jinpar community ka traditional access tha. 
			
			2) Minor Forest PRoduce : ALl non-timber forest produce of plant origin ---> Bamboo,  BRush WOod,  Stumps,  Cane, Tussar,  Cocoons,  Honey wax,  Tendu, herbs, roots, tubers etc
			
			3) Forest Dwelling STs : Jo forest lands me primarily reside karte hain. 
			
			4) Other Traditional FOrest dwellers : 2005 se pehle, jinki at least 3 generations forest me rehti thi, or forest land par depend karti thi. 
			
			5) Critical Wildlife Habitat : MoEFF determine karti hai, NPs or WSs ka wo area---> Jo, required to be kept inviolate for the purpose of Wildlife conservation. 
			
			6) Forest Villages : State Gov ke Forest depts, ne Forests ke andar jo Settlements establish ki hain, for forestry operations
		
		
		
		Lekin, FOrest Dept wale, Gram Sabha ke saath powers share nahi karna chahte for---> COnservation and Mgmt of Forest Resources.

	PIRP(Personal) and CIRP(Company) me difference ye hai ki : 
		
		1) PIRP me, Debtors remain in control of their distressed firm,     lekin,   CIRP me Company ko resolution professionals manage karte hain. 
		
		2) PIRP ko commencement date ke 120 dino ke andar andar pura karna padta hai,      lekin,   CIRP ko 270 din milte hain. 
		
		3) PIRP me, Distressed company, secured creditors or existing owners/investors ke beech ek direct agreement hota hai,    lekin,    CIRP me, Resolution, Open bidding se hota hai. 
		
		
		(Retail Direct Gilt Accounts (RDG Accounts))
	RBI Retail Direct Scheme : Ab--> Small Retail Investors bhi, G-Secs me invest kar sakte hain, central Bank ke saath Gilt Accounts open karke. 
	
		- T-Bills--> 0 coupon Interest Rates(Discount me issue kiye jaate hain),      G-Secs ---> Fixed/Floating Coupon(Interest Rate)---> Generally 5 se 40 saalo ka tenor hota hai. 
		
		- G-Secs ko RBI issue karta hai, auctions ki madad se---> Jinhe, E-Kuber naam ke CBC platform par conduct kiya jata hai. 
		
		- Clearing Corporation of India Limited(CCIL) ---> G-Sec ki clearing agency hai. 
		
			- Acts as central counter Party for all transactions in G-Secs by interposing itself between 2 counterparties. (Ek se kharredke, dusre ko beechti hai)	
		
		- Is se wo khareed sakte hain : i) G-Secs     ii) State Development Loans     iii) Sovereign Gold Bonds
		
		
		
	Operation Twist : RBI iski madad se, Long-Term bond yields ko neeche leke aati hai 
	
		- Bond prices or Bond yields ke beech iNverse relation hota hai. 
		
		- RBI long-term bonds khareed leti hai, jis se bond prices badh jaate hain, jis se yield kam ho jati hai.

	'Matched Fileterin technique' ---> Iska use karke, LIGO ke chodo ne, ek Neutron Star or Black hole ki collision ko detect kiya hai. 
	
		- Is technique ko gravitational waves ki discovery me bhi use kiya gaya tha. 
		
		- Neutron stars, periodic pulses emit karte hain----> Most precise 'clocks' in the Universe.   Ye universe ke sabse densest objects bhi hote hain. 
		
		- Ye, sun se, 1.4-2 times jyada bhari hota hai. 
		
		- Dwarf star : When mas of star is less than 1.44 times mass of sun
		
		- Supernova : When mass of star is greater than 1.44 times mass of sun----> Enough helium remains in the core for fusion reaction--> outer envelop explodes
		
		- Neutron star : When mass of star is between 1.44 to 3 times that of sun
		
		- Black Hole : When star os bigger than 3 times.

	UV rays : Sun se naturally emitt hoti hai.   WAvelenght range : 100 se 400 nm. 
	
	
		- 3 bands me hoti hai : i) UV-A : 315 - 400 nm     
		
					ii) UV-B : 280 - 315 nm
					
				       iii) UV-C : 100 - 280 nm
				      
		- Khali, UV-A or B hi, atmosphere se hokar nikal paati hain, kyunki UV-C ko to ozone hi dhar dabochta hai .
		
		- UV-B : Skin ki outer layer, yani Epidermis tak hi pahonch paati hai, or bas Sun-burn + Chote mote skin cancers hi de paati hai. 
		
		- UV-A : Ye saali, middle layers tak ko penetrate kar jaati hai, jise dermis kehte hain----> Skin cells ki aging kar sakti hai ---> Cell ke DNA ko bhi indirect damage de sakti hai. 
		
		- UV-C : Ye man-made sources se nikalti hai- --> Skin burns + Eye-injuries
		
			- Lekin, ye Disinfaction ke kaam bhi aati hai. ---> SARS-CoV 2 ke airborne transmission ko rokne me bhi kaam aa sakti hai. 
			
			- Ise, Hospitals, Labs me, disinfection ke liye to decades se use kiya ja raha hai, or even water treatment me bhi.

	Sun-Spots : Smaller, Cooler, Darker area but with very strong magnetic forces. 
	
		- Bade sunspots, chote walo ke comparrison me slowly rotate karte hain. 
		
		- Bigger sunspots ke around strong magnetic fiels hoti hai, jis wajas se wo jyada teji se rotate nahi kar paate.     And vice-versa for shorter ones. 
		
		- Earth par---> Solid-mass----> Uniform rotation. 
		
		- But, sun par aisa nahi hai---> Differential rates of rotation. 
		
			Solar equator rotates, faster than its poles. 			
			
		- Sun Counterclockwise direction me rotate karta hai---> Jab north se dekhte hain to.   ---> Ye wahi direction hai jisme planets rotate or orbit karte hain, around sun.

	India ka pehla Cryptogamic Garden : 50 species of lichens, Ferns and Fungi : Uttarakhand ke Dehradun district me. 
	
		- Cryptogamic bole to : "Hidden Reproduction" ---> No Seed, No flowers are produces. ---> Crypotagrams hote hain : Non-Seed bearing plants. 
		
		- Algae,, Bryophytes(moss, liverworts),  lichens,  Ferns  and Fungi ----> Best kknown cryptograms ---> Require Moist conditions to survive.
		
		
			Algae : Most primitive organisms ---> Predominantly aquatic ----> Both in Marine as well as freshwater habitats. 
			
				1) Ye saale, Environment clean karne ke kaam aate hain. 
				
				2) Ye carbohydrates, fat, proteins or Vitams ka healthy source bhi hain 
				
				3) Kai desho me inhe as a food ingredient use kiya jata hai---> China, Japan, Norway, Scotland etc. 
				
				4) Inhe, Liquid Fertilizers ki tarah bhi use kiya ja sakta hai----> Helps in repairing nitrogen levels in the soil. 
			
			
			
			Bryophytes : Simplest or Primitive land plants hote hain---> Algae or Pteridophytes ke beech ke intermediary position occupy karte hain. 
			
			Lickens : Fungus or ALgae ka symbiotic relationship hain
			
			Ferns : Primitive vascular plants ka largest group hai 
			
			Fungi : Multicellular Eckaryotic organism hote hain, lekin heterotrophs hote hain.

	Japanese Encephalitis - Acute Encephalitis Syndrom (JE-AES) : India me 10 million homes hain, 61 JE-AES affected districts me. 
	
		- Caused by 5 assholes: Viruses,  Bacteria,  Parasites,  Fungi  and Spirochetes. 
		
		- Ye ek syndrom hai, na ki koi disease. 
		
		- JE Virus ---> India me AES ka most common cause hai. ----> Malnourished baccho ko sabse jyada affect karta hai. 
		
		- 5 sabse vulnerable states : Assam, Bihar, Tamil Nadu, UP and West Bengal. 
		
		- Bachne ke 5 tareeke : 1) Vaccination  2) Vector COntol  3) Sanitation facility  4) Safe Drinking water   5) Adequate Nurishment
		
		- Jal Jeevan mission se, in gharo me tap water pahonchaya ja raha hai.

			WPA, 1972 
			
			
				1) Schedule 1 : Wo animals jinhe highest protection di gayi hai. 
				
					- Hunting is prohibited
					
					- Wildlife trade is prohibited
					
					- Offences--> Highest penalties
					
					- Ex : Tiger, Lion
					
					
				2) Schedule 2 : Same as upar wala. 
				
					- Ex : Himalayan Brown Bear, King Cobra
					
				3) Schedule 3 and 4 : Ye waale bhi protected hain, lekin penalties 1 or 2 se kaafi kam hai. 
				
					- Ex : Hyena(3),  Swans(4)
					
				4) Schedule 5 : Vermins, jinhe mara ja sakta hai
				
					- Ex : Mice, Rat
					
				5) Schedule 6 : Cultivation, Collection, extractions, trade of plants and its derivatives are prohibited
				
					- Ex : Red and Blue Vanda.

	Tectonic Plates : 
		
		1) Continental Plates : Si-Al
		
		2) Oceanic Plates  : Si-Magnesium


			Oceanic Plates me Basaltic rocks hote hain
			
			Continental wale me, low density granitic rocks hote hain. 



		Pacific Plate > North American > Eurasian > African > Antarctic > Indo-Australian > South-American
		
		

	Minor Plates  ka area 20 million square km se kam hota hai. 
	
		Somali > Nazca > Indian > Amurian > Sunda > Phillippine Sea > Okhotsk > Arabian > Yangtze > Cariean > Cocos > Caroline > Scotia > Burma > New Hebrides
		
		
	Micro Plates : Jinka area 1 million square km se bhi kam ho. 
	
		- Major or Minor plates ke aaju-baaju hoti hain. 	




	
		Cratons : Continental lithosphere ka old and stable part hota hai. 
		
			- Tectonic Plates ke interiors me milte hain. 
			
			- Ancient crystablline basement rock se bane hote hote hain, jinpar sedimentary rock jama ho chuka hota hai. 
			
			- Inki thick crust hoti hai, or deep lithospheric roots hoti hain, jo kai 100 kms tak, mantle ke andar ghusi hoti hain. 

			- Ex : Dharwar or Karnataka Craton,   Amazon Craton,   Kaapvaal Craton in South Aftica,   Gawlor craton in South America




		Indian Plate : 100 million years pehle, Gondwana se alag ho gayi thi. 


				- Ye cretaceuos period ki baat hai. 

				- Ye saala North-east move karne laga asia ki taraf. 
				
				- Isi time, Tethyan OCeanic Crust, Eurasian plate ke neeche subduct hone lagi. 
				
				- In do processes se bane : Indian Ocean or Himalayas. 
				
				- Emerging Himalayas ke south me, plate movement ki wajah se, ek vast trough bana---> Jisme, river-borne sediments aake jama ho gaye. ----> Now constitutes Indo-Gangetic Plain. 

				- Abhi, this plate surives as Penninsular India---> Ye India ka sabse purana or sabse stable part hai.   
					
					- Satpura or Vindhya tak, north me extend hota hai. 



	Indian Coastline : 7517 km----> 5400 km peninsular India me, or 2100 km, Islands me. 
	
		- Mainland coastline : 43% sandy beaches,   11% rocky shores,  46% mudflats or marshy shores. 
		
											- Inhe Tidal Flats or  Slobs bhi kehte hain. ---> Ye coastal wetlands hote hain, Intertidal areas me. 
											
											- Mangrooves. 
											
											- Sheltered areas me milte hain, jaise Bays, bayous, lagoons, estuaries. 
											
											- Ye din me do baar submerge or expose hote hain, intertidal zone me hone ki wajah se. 
											
											- Inhe ghatiya samjha jata hai, or dredging ki madad se, agri land me develop kar diya jata hai. 
											
											
											
											
	Deccan Region : 2 division : Igneous rock plateau with Fertile black soil       and       Gneiss Peneplain with infertile red soil
	
		- Tiruvannamalai : Southern Tip hai deccan ki. 
		
		- Jyadatar nadiya, south me flow karti hai. 
		
		- Plateau ka jyadatar northern part is drained by Godavari River and its tributaries, including Indravati River. 
		
		- Central part is drained by : Tungabhadra and Krishna river, including its tributary Bhima River. 
		
		- Sourthernmost part is drained by : Kaveri River--> Rises in Western Ghats of Karnataka. 
		
							Nilgiri hills ke pass ek Island town hai-- Shivasamudra---> Yaha par south ki taraf bend ho jati hai and then falls into Tamil Nadu. 
							
							Hogenakal Falls ,  Stanley Reservoir  and   Mettur Dam, ispar padte hain. 

		- Eastern Deccan Pt, called Telanana and Rayalaseea : Ye, Massive Granite Rocks se milke bana hai---> Traps rainwater. 
		
		- Jyadar, Basal se bana hai, jo ki ek extrusive igneous rock hai.    Lekin, kuch regions me granite milta hai, jo ki ek intrusive igneous rock hai. 
		
		- Granite, fesic rock hota hai, matlab ki--> It is rich in potassium, feldspar and quartz.    Kyunki ye earth ke deep me, slowly thanda hota hai, isliye---> It has large visible crystals. 
		
		- Lekin, Basalt ek Mafic rock hai---> Rich in pyroxene and/or olivine ---> Both of which are Mg-Fe rich minerals. 
		
		- Basalt un areas me milta hai---> That are spreading.     Granite un areas me milta hai----> That are colliding. 
		
		- Chhotanagpur region--> Rich in Mica and Iron ORe. 
		
		- Golconda region ---> Rich in Diamonds, Gold and other metals.

	Coral Bleaching : Wo process jisme, corals white ho jate hain, kai saare stresses ki wajah se, jaise changes in temperatures, light or nutrients. 
	
		- Coral Polyps, zooxanthellae(Ek tarah ka algae) ko expell kar dete hain.   Ye saali algae, unke tissues ke andar rehti hai.   
		
		- Coral, zooxanthellae ko ghar ke saath saath, Co2 or Ammonium bhi deta hai, jo photosynthesis ke liye jaruri hota hai. 
		
		- Zooxanthellar photosynthetic hoti hain, or jaise jaise pani ka temperature badhta hai, ye reactive oxygen species banana shuru kar deti hain. 
		
		- Ye coral ke liye toxic hota hai. Isliye, coral gand par laat maar kar, zooxanthellae ko Tata-Byebye bol deta hai. 
		
		- Kyunki, zooxanthelae hi jyadatar coral pigment banati hain, isliye, unke chale jane se, coral feeka pad jata hai. ---> Bas calcium carbonate se bana skeleton hi bachta hai. 
		
		- Saare bleached corals white nahi hote, kuch pink bhi hote hain. 
		
		- Bleached coral---> Ye vulnerable hote hain disease or starvation ke.     90% energy, zooxanthellae se milti thi coral ko. 
		
		- Jyadatar bechare bhuke mar jaate hain. 
		
		- Coral reef, 25% of marine life ko shelter provide karte hain. 
		
		- Leading cause hai--> Rising water temperatures.    BC, bas 1 degree rise se bleaching ho jati hai. 
		
		- Great barrier reef ki maa chud rahi hai. 
		
		- Persian/Arabian Gulf ke corals sabse jyada tolerant hai, coral bleaching ke. 

		- 2014 se 2017 ke beech, El Nino ke wajah se, 70% of the coral reefs around the world, damage ho gaye.

		- India me huntng par ban hai.

	Relay croping : 2 ya us se jyada crops ugana, Simultanously, during the part of the life cycle of each. 
	
		- Jab pehli crop, apne growth ke reproductive stage par pahonch jaati hai, tab 2nd crop ko plant kiya jata hai.
		
		- Ex : Redgram --> Base crop for 180 days. 
		
			Groundnut, Onionn, Coriander --> One set of intercrops
			
			Samai/thinai/panivargu --> 2nd set of intercrops
	
	
	Ratooning : Un plants ko ugana, jinka lower part or root, uncut rah jaati hai, after harvesting. 
	
		- Is method of endlessly nahi use kiya ja sakta kyunki, yield kam ho jaati hai after every cycle. 
		
		- Sugarcane, Banana, Pineapple---> Ye 3 saal tak steady yield de sakte hain.

		4) Koi moving part bhi nahi hota---> No noise pollution
		
		5) Hydrogen as a fuel use kiya jata hai, lekin isme combustion nahi hota.

 	Logo ki income badhne se ----> Purchasing power badh jaati hai----> Demand pull inflation aata hai. 
 	
 	Interest rates cut kar dene se---> Investment or Consumer spending badh jaati hai----> Demand boost hoti hai, jis se Demand pull inflation aata hai. 
 	
 	Population badhne se----> Demand apne aap badh jaati hai----> Demand pull inflation aata hai. 
 	
 	
 	
 	
 	
 	
 	Flow variables : Defined over a period of time
 	
 		Ex : Depriciation---> Annuanl allowance for wear and tear----> Over a period of time define kiya jata hai, isliye ye ek flow variable hai. 
 		
 		
 		     Income or Output or Profit ---> They make sense only when a time period is specified. 
 		
 	Stock variables : Ek particular point of time par define kiya jata hai. 
 	
 		Ex : Capital goods 
 	
 		     Inventory---->  Unsold finished/semi-finished goods ka stock
 	
 	
 	
 	
 	
 	
 	
 	Factor cost : Actual cost jo aati hai, koi product/Service banane me. 
 	
 		- Ispar agar, Production tax include kar diya jaaye ----> Basic Price
 		
 		- Basic Price, Factor Cost se jyada hota hai, or Market price se kam hota hai. 
 		
 		- GVA at factor Cost + Net Production taxes = GVA at basic prices
 	
 	
 	
 	Market price = Isme product or production tax, dono included hote hain. 
 	
 		- GVA at factor cost + Net production Taxes + Net product taxes = GVA at market prices
 	
 	
 	
 	
 	Matlab, agar hum GVA at basic prices par, Net product taxes add kar de, to bhi hame GVA at market prices mil jayega.
