  	Diurnal Tide : 1 high tide and 1 low tide during each day. 
  	
  		- Successive high and low tide, same hight ki hoti hai. 
  		
  	Semi-Durnal Tide : 2 high tides and 2 low tides each day. 
  	
  		- Dono laghbhag same height ki hi hoti hai. 
  		
  	Mixed Tide : Tidal cycle, containing 2 high tides and 2 unequal low tides. 	
  	
  	
  	
  	
  	
  	
  	Advance Pricing Agreements(APA) : 
  	
  		- Taxpayers ko madad karte hain, to resolve actual or potential transfer pricing disputes----> Alternate to traditional examination process. 
  		
  		- Taxpayer or Tax authority ke beech ka agreement hota hai, jis se pricing method determine hota hai, for pricing taxpayer's international transactions for future years. 
  		
  	
  	
  		Bilateral APA : 
  		
  			- Taxpayer + Associated Enterprise of the taxpayer in the foreign country + Tax authority of the country(where taxpayer is located) + Foreign tax authority. 
  			
  		
  		Unilateral APA : 
  		
  			- Taxpayer + Tax authority of the country where the taxpayer is located. 
  			
  			
  			
  		Multilateral APA(MAPA) : 
  		
  			- Taxpayer, two or more AEs of the taxpayer in different foreign countries, both tax authorities.

  	Lymphatic Filariasis : Elephant leg
  	
  		1) Ye koi viral disease nahi hai
  		
  		2) Parasitic worms ki wajah se hoti hai, jo lymphatic system ke andar rehte hain. 
  		
  		3) microfilaria parasite, ka larva, khoon me circulate karta hai, or ek bande se dusre bande me transmitt ho jata hai, by mosquitoes. 
  		
  		4) 4 tarah ke mosquito se transmitt ho sakta hai : Culex, Mansonia, Anopheles and Aedes
  		
  		5) Ye ek tarah ka Neglected Tropical Disease hai----> 
  		
  		6) India 2 NGTs ko eliminate karne ka man bana chuka hai :--> THis one and    Visceral Leishmaniases(Kala-Azar)

 	Forward Contract : 
 	
 		1) Kisi commodity ka transaction contract hai, jo seller or buyer ko bind karta hai, kisi future date par, commodity ko deliver karne ke liye. 
 		
 		2) Jo price agree karte hain, use, Forward rate kehte hain. 
 		
 		
 		
 	Preference Shares : 
 	
 		1) Company ke wo shares jinka dividend common divident wale stocks se pehle, preference share wale stakeholders ko diya jata hai. 
 		
 		2) Ye koi debt instrument nahi hai. 
 		
 		3) Liquidity ke time bhi inhe hi sabse pehle niptaya jata hai. 
 		
 		
 	Indian Depository Receipt : 
 	
 		1) Ye wo DRs hoti hain, jo Indian Rupees me denominated hoti hain, jinhe India me, Domestic depository issue karti hain. 
 		
 		2) Ye, company ki ownership share deti hai, equity ke mafik. 
 		
 		3) Iski madad se, Foreign companies, Indian equity markets me, companies ke shares le sakti hain.---> Foreign companies ko Indian Equity market me, list hone par ban hai. 
 		
 		4) Ye IDRs bhi, Indian Stock Exchanges par listed hoti hain. 
 		
 		
 	Commercial Paper : 
 	
 		1) YE short-term debt instrument hai, jise comapnes issue karti hain, to raise funds, for a period up to one year. 
 		
 		2) Ye ek unsecured money market instrument hai, jise p-note ki form me issue kiya jata hai. 
 		
 		3) Ise, 1990 me introduce kiya gaya tha India me.

 	Economic Capital : 
 	
 		- Ye wo risk capital hota hai, jo Central Bank ke paas hona jaruri hai, to cover all its risks related to assets and ongoing activites, such as market risks, operational risks etc. 
 		
 		- Expressed as Contigency fund plus revaluation reserve, and such other minor components as, asset-development fund. 
 		
 		- Economic Capital Framework ke undr, RBI risk capital hold karti hai. 	
 		
 		
 		
 		
 	NBFCs or Banks ke beech me, primary difference ye hota hai, ki NBFCs ke deposits insured nahi hote. 
 	
 		- RBI does not gurantee repayment of deposits by NBFCs. 
 		
 		
 	   Lekin, NBFCs ko bhi, Banks ki tarah, minimum CAR maintain karni padti hai. 
 	   
 	   	- Banks ka CRAR/CAR 9% hai. 
 	   	
 	   	- NBFCs ka CRAR/CAR 15% hai. ---> Jisme, 10% Tier 1 Capital or baaki Tier 2 capital me hai. 	
 		
 	
 	NBFCs, min 12 mahine or max, 60 mahine tak hi public deposit accept kar sakti hai. 
 	
 		- Ye Demand Deposits accept nahi kar sakti. 
 		
 		- RBI ki ceiling se upar, Interest rates offer nahi kar sakti. 
 		
 		- Depositors ko koi extra gift/incentive bhi nahi offer kar sakti. 
 		
 		- NBFCs ke pass min. investment grade credit rating honi chaiye.

 	Personal Disposable Income = Personal Income - Personal Tax payment - Non-Tax Payment
 	
 		- Ye aggregate income ka wo part hota hai, jo households ko belong karta hai. 
 	
 		- Govt transfers se disposable income badhti hai, or taxes se kam hoti hai. 
 	
 	Personal Income = Natioanl Income - Undistributed profits - Net Interest payments made y households - Corporate tax + Transfer payments to the households from the gov and firms. 	
 		
 		
 		
 	National Disposable Income se idea hota hai, what is the max amount of Goods and Services the domestic economy has at its disposal. 	
 		
 		National Disposable Income = Net National Product at market prices + Other current transfers from the rest of the world.

 	Bacteria or Blue green algae : Prokaryotes :----> Inme, nuclear membrance nahi hoti.
 	
 	Eukaryotes, Multicellular dono ho sakte hain. 
 	
 	
 	
 	Eukaryotes me, kaafi saare membrane-bound organelles hote hain, jo prokaryotic cells me nahi hote. 
 	
 		- Mitochondia 
 		
 		- Rough and smooth endoplasmic reticulum ---> Synthesized protein ko transfer karne ke liye hota hai. 
 		
 		- Golgi complex---> Proteins ko sort and package kart hai. 
 		
 		- CMhloroplasts--> Ye plant cells me hota hai, photosynthesis karne ke liye. 
 	
 	
 	
 	Eukaryoticm cells ke ribosome, bigger or complex hote hain, or membrane se bounded hote hain. 
 		
 		- Ye kaafi saari jagah mil sakte hain, jiase ki cytoplasm ke andar, Endoplasimc reitculum ke upar, ya fir nuclear memerane se chipke hue. 
 		
 	Lekin, prokaryotic cells ke ribosomes, cytoplasm me free float kar rahe hote hian, or scattered hote hain.    Inke ribosomes, ki chodti subunits hoti hain. 
 	
 	
 	
 	Jyadatar, eukaryotes, sexually reproduce karte hain---> Lekin, kuch prtists ya single celled dungi, mitosis ke through bhi reproduce kar sakte hain. ---> Jo ek tarah ka asexual reproduction hai. 
 	
 	- Prokaryotes, asexually reproduce karte hain, Jis wajah se unka iffspring, exact clone hota hai prarent ka. 
 	
 	
 		
 		
 		
 	Jyadatar prokaryotic cells me rigid cell wall hoti hai, jo plasma membrane ko surround karti hai, 
 	
 		- Eukaryotes ke case me, bas plants ke andar cell wall hoti hai. 
 		
 		- Bacteria ke cell wall---> Sugar or amino acids, a.k.a Peptidoglycans se bani hoti hai----> Bacteria ke case me, antibiotics, isi ko target karti hain. 
 		
 		- Lekin, plants ki cell wall cellulose se bani hoti hai. 	
 		
 		
 		
 		
 		
 		
 	200 different tarah ke viruses common cold de sakte hain. 
 		
 		- Rhinovirus sabse common hai----> 30-40% cases, yahi choda lata hai. 
 		
 		- Other- Coronavirus, Adenovirus, syncytial virus and parainfluenza virus.

		Vote of Credit : Kisi Service ke indefinite character ke hone ki wajah se, demand ko budget ki details me ordinarily state nahi kiya ja sake.

		Exceptional Grant : Ye kisi specific purpose ke liye di jaati hai---> Forms no part of the current service of any financial year. 
		
		
		Excess Grant : Jab, kisi service par, granted amount se jyada kharcha ho jaye. 
		
			- Voted by the Lok Sabha after the financial year. 
			
			- Ise, Lok Sabha me laane se pehle, Parliament ki Public Accounts committee se approve karwana padta hai.

	Zero Hour : Neither mentioned in constitution, nor in Rules of Procedure. 
	
		- Informal Device to MPs to raise matters without any prior notice. 
		
		- Question Hour ke baad shuru hota hai, and lasts until the agenda of the day. 		Matlab Question hour and Agenda ke beech ka time.
		
		- 1962 ke baad se hai.   IT is an Indian invention. 
		
	
	
	Quorum : Provided in Article 100 of Constitution of India. 
	
		- 1/10th of the Total members in each house, including the presiding officer. 
		
		- Matlab---> There must be 55 members in Lok SAbha     and      25 members in Rajya Sabha
		
		- Quorom na hone par, Presiding officer, ya to house to adjourn kar deta hai, ya fir Qurum na ho jane tak, suspend kar deta hai. 
		
	
	
	
	Prorogation : Article 85 of Constitution. 
	
		- Session ka business pura ho jane par, Presiding officer declares the House Adjourned sine die. 
		
		- Kuch dino baad, President issues a notification for prorogation of the session. 
		
		- Lekin, President Can prorogue the House while in Session.

	Archaea : Single-celled prokaryotic organism ----> Ye bacteria se alag hai. 
	
		(Bacteria bhi prokaryotic hota hai)
		
		
		
		- Ye slow growing organism hote hain. 
		
		- Ye extreme hot and cold environments me bhi jinda reh sakte hain. 
		
		- Ye un organisms ka attack bhi jhel lete hain, jo bacteria ki maa chod dete hain. 	
		
		- Ye saala, oxygen-gree environment(Anerobic) me bhi survive kar sakta hai. 
		
		- Eco-freindly waste treatment me kaam aa sakte hain. 
		
		- Ye saale, mere gut, skin or mouth me bhi present hain. 
		
		- BC, methanogens ek type ke archea hi hai. 
		
		- Abhi abhi, Rajasthan ki sambhar lake me, ek naya archea mila hai, National Centre for Microbial Resorce ko.

 	Diastrophism : WO saari processes, jo move, elevate ya build up karti hai, earth ki crust ko. 
 	
 		-Orogeny me,  Crust is severely deformed into folds. ---> Is se mountains bante hain.
 		
 			 - Rock masses move in tangential direction to earth's surface. 
 			 
 			 
 		- Epeirogeny ki wajah se, crust ka simple deformation hota hai. ---> It involves upliftment and wrapin of large parts of earth's crust. ---> Is se continents bante hain. 
 		
 			- Rock masses move in radial or vertical direction to earth's surface
 		
 		
 		
 	Appalachians and Urals  ===> Very old Fold Mountains
 	
 	Vosges and Rhine Valley ---> Block mountains
 	
 					- Meghalayan Pt bhi ek tarah ka block mountain hai. 
 					
 					- Earth crust ki horizontal movement ki wajah se, plates move away from each other. ---< Is se faulting hoti hai.

				- Ek verification regime tayyar kiya hai, to monitor adherence to treaty 	: International Monitoring System(IMS),  Internaitonal Data Centre(IDC)  and On-Site Inspection(OSI)
				
				- Planet ko constantly monitor karta hai, for nuclear explosions.

		 Protein Folding

- Amino Acids ke merger se jo proteins bante hain, unme 10 raised to the power 150 tak, type ke folded structures mil sakte hain.

- To ye pata lagana bohot mushkil hota hai ki, protein fold kaisa dikhega.

- Iske liye, CASP naam ka ek competition karwaya jata hai, jisme. Log predict karte hain, folded protein ki structue.

- Oh, ALS disease, Madcow disease etc, ghatiya protein folding ki wajah se hi hoti hai.

- Now back to the competition.   Isme, jitna close prediction hai, real structure ke, uske basis se, out of 100% score kiya jata hai, teams ko.

- Generally teams ko 10-20% tak mil paat tha.

- Lekin, last 2 saalo me,  Google ki AI company Deep Mind, ne 90% score kiya hai.

- To is se, Protein folding predict karna bohot easy ho gaya hai.

- Lekin, AI ko bhi data chahiye, predict karne ke liye. Jin proteins ke liye data nahi hai, unke structures determine nahi kiye jaa sakte.

- Lekin, is AI ki wajah se, scientist log, khudke protein structrues bana sakte hain, jis se Cancer jaise bimari se lada jaa sakta hai.

	IBC code, 2016	


		Insolvency : Jab saala kisi entity ki liabilities jyada ho jayen, unke assests se, or wo entity apne karje modne me unable ho jaye. 
		
		
		Bankruptcy : Jab entity khudke insolvent declare kare, or fir court legal process ke through us entity ko insolvent declare kare. 


				IBC code bas 4 tarah ki entities par apply hota hai : i) Individuals    ii) Partnerships firms     iii) LLPs     iv) Companies
				
				IBC inpar apply nahi hota : Societies, Trust boars etc. 



					- Debtor, ya creditor dono Insolvency process start kar sakte hain. 
					
					- NCLT ke aage application file karke process kar sakte hain, agar 1 crore se jyada hai default hai to. 

					- IBC ke 4 pillars hain : i) IPs    ii) Info Utilities    iii) Adjucating Authories --> NCLT (Companies or LLPs ke liye),  DRT (Individuals or Partnership firms ke liye)  iv) IBBI
					
					- IBBI bole to Insolvency and Bankruptcy board of India. 
					
						- Iska kaam hai  
								a) Infra setup karna
								
								b) IPs ko accredit karna
								
								c) Regulate karna--> CIRP (Resolution process), Liquidation, Individual insolvency and Bankruptcy. 


					- Resolution Process start hone par, NCLT resolution professionals(IRP) appoint karti hai. 
					
					- Ye saaale fir, Karje wali company ke affairs manage karte hain. 
					
					- Ye fir sab karje dene wale logo ko bulake unki ek-  Committee of Creditos(CoC) banati hai, or bolti hai ki, "Haan bhai batao kis kis ne kitna kitna karja diya tha". 
					
					- CoC fir, naya IRP appoint kar sakti hai, ya usi chode se kaam chala sakti hai. 

					- CoC me bas Financial Creditors(Jaise ki banks) part ho sakte hain, operational creditors(wo chutiye jinhone input ya other material diya tha kaam ke liye) nahi. 

					- Fir ek Resolution plan laaya jaata hai. --> Isme merger, demerger type chutiyaap kiya jaa sakta hai(66% approval)---> Fir is plan ko NCLT ke aake present kiya jata hai. 

					- NCLT accept na kare to liquidation process start hoti hai. ---> Isme saale karje wale bande ke saare assets ki nilami kar di jaati hai. 
					
					- Even though Operational Creditors ko CoC ka part nahi banate lekin, jyadatar cases me, yahi chode NCLT ke aake application file karte hain, process start karne ki. 
					
					
			IBC ki wajah se, Average resolution time, 4.3 years se ghatkar, 1.6 years ho gaya hai, in 2020. 			
					
					
			Lekin, Liquidation ke cases bohot jyada hain, or Resolution wale cases bohot kam. 
			
			Banks ne 62% haircut face kiya hai, overall. 
			(Saala SARFAESI act ke under, 26% wasooli(recovery) ho jaati thi, yaha to bas 39% hai---> To kya jhant ukhada hai)		
					
					
			2021 me IBC amdmt bill se, 1 crore se kam ke cases walo ke liye --- > Pre-packaged Insolvency reolution process(PIRP) leke aaye hain.

		Basel Convention : 
		
			i) Radioactive Waste ko cover nahi karta hai. 	Ships ke operation me jo waste generate hota hai, wo bhi cover nahi hota. 
			
			ii) Developed desh se, LDCs me Hazardous waste na pahonch jaye, iske liye hai. 
			
			iii) 1989 me sign hui thi. 
		
			iv) Saala USA or HAiti, do hi aise desh hain, jinhone ise ratify nahi kiya hai. 
			
			v) 2019 me, Plastic Waste ko bhi isme add kar diya gaya tha. 

		
		
					Bamako Convention : African desho ki convention hai -   "Bahan ke lodo, apna waste apne paas rakho, Nigga". 



		Kisi Treaty ko 'To enter into Force' ke liye, 3/4th of the member states ko ratify karna hota hai.

 a== 
 
 		Nano Particles : 
 		
 			1) 1 se 100 nm ke particles  -- Ye IUPAC ne define kiya hai. 
 			
 			2) 1 nm se chote particles ko atom clusters kehte hain. 
 			
 			3) Microplastics alag hote hain : 1 se 1000 micro meters. 
 			
 			4) Inpar brownian motion lagta hai, isliye, ye sediment nahi hote colloidal particles ki tarah, jinki range, 2500 se 10,000 nm tak hoti hai. 		
		
			5) Visible light ki wavelength se kaafi chote hone ki wajah se, inhe dekhne ke liye, Electron microscopes ka use karna padta hai. 
			
			6) Variety of shapes : Nanorods, Nanofibers, Nanoboxes, Nanoreefs, Nanochains etc
		
			7) Inka Surface Area/ Volume  ration, kaafi jyada hota hai. 
		
			8) Ye quantum effects bhi show karte hain. 
			
			9) Uses : 
			
			       i) Carbon Nanotubes : Vehicles, Sports equipments, ICs
			       
			       ii) Cerium Oxide : Electronics,  Biomedical supplies, energy, Fuel additives
			       
			       iii) Titanium Dioxide : Sunscreens, Cosmetics, Pains, Coatings
			       
			       iv) Nano Silver : Textiles, Cloathing, Food Packaging, Eliminate Bacteria
			       
			       v) Nano Scale Iron : Iron-Nutrient Suppliment : Remove containment from groundwater
		
		
		
		
		
	Asbestos se ye sab bimariya hoti hain : Asbestosis,   Mesothelioma,    Lung Cancer,   Diffuse Pleural Thickening		
		
		- Basel Convention ke Annex I me mentioned hai. 
		
		- India se lekin, abhi bhi export ho raha hai : Compressed Asbestos Fiber (CAF) gasket, Ropes, Cloth,  Gland Packings, Milloards, Insulation, Brake liners
		
		- Ise, pehle Fire Retardant samjha jaata tha, High Electrical Resistance bhi thi, Sasta bhi tha. 
		
		- Lekin, asbestos ke sharp fibers, lungs ki maa chod dete hain.  
		
		- India me, Asbestos cement sheets or cement blocks bante hain, lol.

		- Israel ne sign kiya tha, lekin ratify nahi kiya

		- 1925 wali Geneva Convention ne, bas use par ban lagaya tha, na ki production par.

		- OPCW naam ki organisation adminster karti hai. 
		
		- 3 schedules hain : 
		
		       1) Schedule 1 : Jinka bas military use hai Ex : Sulfur Mustard, Nerve Agents etc
		       
		       2) Scheduel 2 : Jinke, legitimate small scale applications hain. Ex : Thiodiglycol, jo inks me solvent ki tarah use hota hai.  
		       
		       3) Schedule 3 : Jinke, Large scale uses hain Ex: Phosgene ---> Lekin, non CWC members ko export par ban hai. 		

		- Bechare India ne, 2009 me hi, 100% stockpile destroy kar diya tha, Lekin India ke pass declared Chemical Weapons Production Facility hai.

       Adjournment Motion : 
       
          1) Primary motive hota hai iska---> Kisi urgent public importance ke upar, house ka attention dilwana
          
          2) Ye ek extraordinary procedure hai, jo agar admit ho gaya to---> House ke normal business ko set aside kar diya jata hai----> Taaki us definite matter par discussion ki jaa sake. 
          
          3) Iska directly ya indirectly, Union gov ke conduct se kuch na kuch lena dena hona chahiye.. 
          
          4) State gov ke jurisdiction me kuch aata hai, to wo discuss nahi ho sakta. 
          
          5) Lekin  SC ST ke saath agar state me kuch hua hai, to wo discuss ho sakta hai. 
          
          6) Ek member 1 sitting ke liye, 1 se jyada notice nahi de sakta
          
          7) Or BC sabse important---> Chair ki marji hai, ki wo allow karta hai ya nahi, or agar allow nahi karta to bhi use koi reason weason dene ki jarurat nahi hai. 
          
          8) Adjournment motion ko consent dete time, Speaker ko ye sab baate dhyan me rakhni hoti hain. 
          
              i) Matter, Definite, urgent or Public Importance ka hai
              
             ii) Recently kuch hua hai, usi se related hai
             
            iii) Pivilege ka koi question raise na karta ho
            
             iv) Same session me jo cheeze discuss ho chuki hai, sala ghum firke wahi na revive kar de.

              NUCLEIC CHUTIYAAP : 
              
              
                1) 3 Tarah ka RNA hote hain : 
                
                    - Messanger RNA ----> Ye genetic code ke ek portion ki copy karta hai, or is process ko transcription kehte hain. 
                       (mRNA) 
                                          - Ye fir is copy ko ribosomes tak transport karta hai----> Jo Cellular factories hoti hain----> Yahi betichod, proteins banate hain, is code ka use karke. 
                                          
                                          
                    - Transfer RNA -----> Ye saale, un Ribosomes tak, Amino acids ko leke aate hain, jinse bade proteins banaye jaate hain. ----> Ye Protein ban ne ki process ko translation kehte hain. 
                      (tRNA)
                    
                    
                    - Ribosomal RNA ----> Ye Ribosome Factory ka hi part hai, jiske bina, protein ki produciton nahi ho sakti. 
                       (rRNA)     
                
                
                
                2) RNA single stranded hota hai. 
                
                3) RNA, nucleus me hi bante hain, or fir waha se nikalkar cytoplams ke specialised regions me chale jaate hain. 
                
                      ( DNA bas Nucleus me hi milta hai, lekin thoda sa Mitochondria me bhi milta hai )
                      
                      
                      
                4) RNA, kaafi jyada resistant hota hai, UV rays se damage ke.    DNA ki aasani se maa chud jaati hai, UV rays se. 
                      
                
                
                
                
                
                
        India ne khudki, pehli mRNA vaccine banai hai. 
        
          1) Inhe pathogen particles, ya inactivated pathogens se nahi banaya jata ---> To ye non-infectious hoti hain.   Ye baar, protein ke bande hi, RNA strand degrade ho jaata hai. 
          
          
          2) Ye stronger immune response generate kar sakti hain, Side effects bhi kam hote hain. 
          
          
          3) Lab, me kaafi rapidly banai jaa sakti hain.
          
          
          4) Fucntion : 
          
              - Ye mRNA strand intoduce karti hain, jo coded hota hai, ek disease specific antigen ke liye. 
              
              - Jaise hi body ke andar antigen banta hai, ise immune system recognise kar leta hai, jis se wo tayyar ho jata hai, real chode se ladne ke liye. 
              
          
          5) Needle se, blood me, muslce me, lymph node, ya BC seedha organs me, ya Nasal Spray ke jariye, kaise bhi daal sakte hain. 
          
          
          6) mRNA vaccines bhi kai tarah ki hoti hain :--> Non-Replicating mRNA,  In vivo self-replicating mRNA, In-Vitro dendritic cell non-replicating mRNA vaccine etc
          
          
          7) Inhe store karne ke liye, Refrigeration ki jarurat bhi nahi padti, unlike, Traditional vaccines---> Ex : Subunit, toxoid, conjugate, live attenuated, vira-cectored vaccines etc.

         Electric Powered Spacecraft Propulsion :

           Neutron Stars : 
           
           
              - Ek supergiant star(JO apne sun se 10 ya 25 guna jyada mass ka hota hai) ki collapsed core hoti hai ye. 
              
              - Ye bhayanak chote, or bhayanak bhaari hote hain. 
              
              - Inki radius bas 10 km ke aaspass hoti hai. ----> Inka Mass, Sun ke dedh dhai guna tak hota hai. 
              
              - Jab, Massive Stars, Supernova explosion me shaheed ho jaate hain + Gravitational Collapse ===>> Core compress hokar, White Dwarf se bhi jyada choti ho jati hai. 
              
              - AIsa hone ke baad, ye heat generate nahi karte---> Time ke saath Saath thande hote rehte hain. 
              
              - Ye entirely Neutron se milke bane hote hain---> Electrons or Protons combine hoke, Neutron bana dete hain. 
              
              - Inhe Further collapse hone se, Neutron Degeneracy pressure bachaata hai.  [White dwarfs ko further collapse hone se, Electron degeneracy pressure bachata hai]
              
              - Lekin, agar, iska mass 2 solar masses se jyada hota hai, to ye pressure + repulisve force bhi hold nahi kar paati, collapse hone se, or betichod ka, Black hole ban jata hai. 
              
              - Ye bhayanak garam hote hai---> Surface temperatures---> 6 lakh kelvin. 
              
              - Inki Magnetic Field earth se 10 raised to the power 15 guna tak strong ho sakti hai. 
              
              - Jab star collapse hone lagta hai, tab uski rotation speed badh jaati hai, to ye saala har second me kai 100 baar ghumta hai. 
              
              - Is wajah se betichod, kuch Neutron starts, EM radiation ke beams emit karte hain----> Pulsars. 
              
              - Akele Milkey way galaxy me 1 billion Neutron Stars hain.

       FUSION : 
       
       
           1) Temperature, Pressure, confinement time  + Fuel ki madad se plasma banate hain, jisme Fusion hota hai. 
           
           2) In conditions ko 'Lawson Criterion' kehte hain. 
           
           3) Taaro me, Fuel hota hai, Hydrogen, or Connfinement time provide karta hai gravity. 
           
           4) Reactors me, Hydrogen ke isotopes use honge : Deuterium and Tritium ---> Ye Hydrogen se jyada aasani se aapas me react karte hain, jis se Lawson criterion less extreme conditions me reach ho jata hai. 
           
           5) Lekin, Fuel ko 100 million degrees ta heat karna padta hai. 
           
           6) Fayde : 
           
                  - Reduced radioactivity
                  
                  - Less nuclear waste
                  
                  - ample fuel supplies
                  
                  - increased safety
                             
           7) Abhi tak ka asia koi bhi design nahi hai, jo input se jyada output power de de. 
           
           8) Or, jo Neutrons bandte hain, reaction ke time, wo, saale reaction me use hone wale materials ko degrade kar dete hain. 
           
           9) 3 main concepts use hote hain : z-pinch,  Stellarator  and magnetic mirror. 
           
          10) Ye reaction bas, Iron-56 se chote nuclei ke liye, hi exothermic hoti hai---> Kyunki is se bade walo me, protons jyada hote hain, jis se kaafi jyada repulsive force lagta hai. 
          
          11) Hydrogen me bas ek hi proton hota hai, isliye, ye sabse aasan, or sabse jayda energy output deta hai, plus 1 hi electron hone ki wajah se, ise ionize karna bhi aasan hai. 
          
          12) Temperature to achieve ho jata hai, lekin, jitne time me ye fuse hote hain, utne me, diffusion ki wajas ke leakage ho jata hai, isiliye, ITER wala reactor bhayanak bada hai.        
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
       Tipping Point : Ek Climate system me, wo threshold hota hai, jis se, aise irreversible changes jo kafi bade bhi hote hain. ---> inse, Insano ke maa chudne ka khatra badh jata hai.            
                  
                  
                  
                  
                  
        Westerlies :
        
        
            1) 30 se 60 degree latitudes ke beech (yani mid lats) ki prevailing winds hain. 
            
            2) Horse lats ke High pressure areas me originate hoti hain---> Poles ki taraf jaati hai---> Extratropical cyclones ko steer karti hui. 
            
            3) Northern Hemisphere me---> Southwest ki taraf se ( New York se Crystal ki choot me )   Or Southern Hemisphere me ( Brazil se South Africa ki taraf)
            
            4) Winter me strong ho jaati hai, jab poles pe pressure kam hota hai
            
            5) Southern Hemisphere me to ye bhayanak strong hoti hain --->'Brave West Winds' --> Chile, Tanzania or New zealand me. 
            
            6) South me land kam hota hai isliye
            
            7) Ye Warm, equitorial waters and winds ko Continents ke western coasts tak bhejti hain---> SPecially southern Hemispheres me. 
            
            8) Winter me ye itni majboot ho jaati hai ki, BC Gobi desert se dust plumes udata hua aata hai, USA me. 
            
            9) Westerlies ki strengths ki wajah se hi, North wale currents bhi Southern hemisphere walo se kamjor hote hain. 
            
           10) Western Intensification naam ki process ki wajah se West se east jaane wale currents, western coasts ki taraf strongest hote hain---> Is wajah se, Westerlies, bhayanka garam pani pahonchati hai, Europe ki choot me
           
           11) Antarctic Circumpolar Current, Antarctica ke aasapaas, west se east ki taraf jaata hai---> Ye duniya ka sabse bada current hai--->Ise, West Wind Drift bhi kehte hain. 
           
           12) North me---> Gulf Stream hai, usa wala,       japan ke pass---> Kuroshio hai---> Strong Western Boundry current        Ye dono khuub saare, ocean cyclones llaate hain. 
           
           
           13) Extra Tropical Cyclones :
           
           
                 - Ye na to polar jaise hote hain, na hi Tropical cyclones jaise
                 
                 - Ye mid-lats yaani, USA wale me milte hain. 
                 
                 - Ye everyday phenomenon hain       Inhe Baroclinic kehte hain----> Kyunki ye temperature or Dewpoint gradients ke along bante hain

       RetroVirus : 
       
       
         1) Ye ek aisa virus hota hai, jo apne RNA genome ki ek copy, host cell ke DNA me insert kar deta hai. 
         
         2) Is se, Host Cell ka genome hi change ho jata hai. 
         
         3) Ye Host cell ke cytoplasm me jata hai, or khudka Reverse Transcriptase enzyme use kar, DNA banane lagta hai, from it's RNA genome-------> Jo normally hota hai, uska ulta--> Isiliye, RETRO. 
         
         4) Fir ye wala DNA jake wo, host cell ke genome me insert kar deta hai, using Integrase enzyme. ----> Ab retroviral DNA ko ProVirus kehte hain. 
         
         5) Fir bechari cell, use viral DNA ko bhi apne hi Genome ka hissa samjhke, viral genese ko bhi transcribe or translate karne lagti hai, along with cell's own genes. 
         
         6) Is se jo proteins bante hain, unse Virus ki nayi copies banai jati hai. 
       
         7) Ex : HIV,  Human T-lymphotropic virus(HTLV),   Murine Leukemia virus--> Ye undar jaati me cancer kar deta hai. 
         
         8) Lekin, inka use, Gene Delivery systems ke tor par bhi kiya jata hai.

           - Is se, Hepetitas B, C  or Sars Cov 2 ka bhi detection ho sakta hai. 
           
           - Is se food industry me bhi food allergens ko detect kiya  ja sakta. 
           
           - BC, Malaria, Dengue, Johne's disease ec sab dhundh leti hai Teri ELisa.

       ISRO
       
       
         - World ki pehli agency hai to find water on moon. 
         
         - World's largest constellation of remote sensing satellites..

             1) GAGAN : GPS-aided GEO augmented navigation
             
                 - Ise, Airport Authority ne 2008 me banaya tha, with help of ISRO. 
                 
                 - Indian Airspace ke upar se, jani wali flights ko navigation system provide karna. 
       
                 - Ye India ke upar ke Ionosphere region ko study karega.

             2) NAVIC : Indian Regional Navigational satellite System 
             
                    - Covers India and region extending 1500km around it. 
                    
                    - 8 satellites ka constellation hai, Plus 2 satellites jo ground pe hoti hai, as stand by. 
                    
                    - 2 tarah ki service provide karta hai : i) Standard Positioning Service : Open for Civilian use    ii) Restricted Service (encrypted one) : For authenticated a.k.a military users. 
                    
                    - India ke commercial vehicles me NavIC based trackers lagana compulsory hai. 
                    
                    - Ise, USA ke National Defense Authorisation Act ke under, US Defense secy ne, Galileo or OZSS ke saath, Allied Navigational satellite system designate kiya hua hai.      
       
                    -Inme se 5 satellites ko Geosynchoronous orbits me rakha gaya hai, or baaki ki 3 Geostationary orbit me hai(Earth se 36,000 km upar).  
        
                     - ISRO wale ab, France, Japan or Australia ke Cocos(Keeling) Islands me bhi NavIC ground station establish karne ki baate kar rahe hain.

           - LAUNCH Vehicles  : 
           
               1) PSLV :  Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle
               
                   - Pehla, medium lift launch vehicle hai India ka.

                   - 50 se jyada launches kar chuka hai

                   - 1st Stage - Duniya ka sabse bada Solid ROcket booster ---> HTPB propellant use karta hai.    PSLV G or XL wale, me 6 strap on solid boosters bhi lage hote hain. 
                   
                   - 2nd Stage- Vikas Engine - liquid propellent 
                   
                   - 3rd Stage- Firse Solid propellent   HTPB 
                   
                   - 4th Stage- Regenratively cooled twin engines ---> MMH and MON use hota hai--- Liquid .  ( Iski madad se, multiple orbits me satellites fenki jaati hain)
                   
                   - PSLV ke saare 53 launches(50 successes), Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota se hi hue hain. 
                
                2) GSLV : Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle
                
                      - Ise, Geostationary orbits me satellites ko fenkne ke liye banaya tha.

                      - USA ne lund ada diye the, Russia se Cryogenic tech lene ke liye. 
                      
                      - Iske baad, India ne khudka Cryogenic tech develop kiya. 
                      
                      - 3 stages hain isme : Solid, Liquid or fir last Cryogenic. 
                      
                      - L40 H naam ke 4 boosters use karta hai.   Inme 2 Hypergolic propellents hote hain ---> UDMH or N2o4   (Ye dono ek dusre ke contact me aate hi, BC kutte ki tarah ignite kar dete hain) 
                      
                      - 1st Stage : Solid 
                      
                      - 2nd Stage : Vikas Engine
                      
                      - 3rd Stage : Desi, CE-7.5 cryogenic rocket engine ---> Isme, Liquid Hydrogen and Liquid Oxygen use hoti hai ----> Ise, Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre ne banaya hai. 
                      
                      - Sabse pehla successfull launch tha : 2014 me--> GSAT-14 ka.     
                  
                 3) GSLV Mark III : Ise LVM3 bhi kehte hain. 
                 
                       - ISRO ka sabse bhari rocket hai.

             LOk Sabha ke dissolve hone par, ye sab hota hai : 
             
              
                
                1) Committee on Government assurance ke pass jo bills hain, wo lapse nahi hote. 
                
                
                2) Lok Sabha me pending bill lapse ho jaate hain, chahe wo lok sabha me originate hua ho, ya Rajya Sabha se pass hoke aaya ho. 
                
                
                3) Lok Sabha ne jo bill pass karke, Rajya Sabha me bheja tha, or Kapil Sibbal ki wajah se waha pending me hi pada raha,  Lapse ho jata hai
                
                
                4) Agar President ne kisi bill ke liye, Joint Sitting ki baat kardi hai, to wo bhi lapse nahi hota  
                
                
                5) Rajya Sabha me pending bill, jo Lok Sabha se pass nahi hua hai, Lapse nahi hota. 
                
                
                6) Dono Houses ne jo bill pass kar diya hai, lekin bas president ka assent baki hai, wo bhi lapse nahi  hoti
               
               
                7) Or to or, jo bill president ne reconsideration ke liye wapas bheja tha, wo bhi lapse nahi hota.

       Ryotwari System : 
       
        
           1) Ise, Sabse pehle, Tamil Nadu me introduce kiya gaya, fir ye----> Maharashtra, Berar, East Punjab, Coorg or Assam me extend kar diya gaya. 
           
           2) Ise, Sir...BC, khudko Sir Bolta hai,ye....Sir Thomas Munro ne 1820 me introduce kiya tha. 
           
           3) "Ryot"---> Individual cultivator ki responsibility hoti thi, ki land revenue dega, seedha, State koi.    Koi baniya-beecholiya nahi. 
           
           4) Ise, Permanent nahi kiya gaya tha. ----> Har 20-30 saalo me periodically revise karte the, or Revenue demand ko badha dete the, saale, napunsak [Bengal ke Permanent Settlement me aisa nahi hota tha]
           
           5) Is system me, Peasant or Cultivators ko, owners of land ki tarah, regard kiya jata tha. ----> Inke pass ownership rights hote the, or ye Sell, mortgage ya land gift bhi kar sakte the. 
           
           
           
           
           
           
           
      Code of Wages act se ye 4 laws----> i) Payment of Wages act,1936   ii) Minimum Wages Act, 1948    iii) Payment of Bonus Act, 1965     iv) Equal Remuneration Act, 1976 ----> Replace ho gaye hain. 
      
         - Ye sab employees par applied hai. 
         
         - Central Gov, wage related decisions legi, for employments such as railways, mines and oil fields, among others. 
         
         - State Govs ---> Baaki sab employments ke liye, decisions legi. 
         
         
         
         - Floor Wage-----> Central Gov, ek Floor Wage decide karegi-----> Workers ke living standards ko dhayn me rakhte hue. 
         
         - GoI, Different geographical areas ke liye, diff floor wages, set kar sakti hai. 
         
         - Lekin, aisa karne se pehle, Gov advice legi, Central Advisory board ka---> oR State govs se bhi consult karegi, 
         
         - Central or State govs, jo bhi minimum wages, set karengi, wo Floor wages se higher hongi.  Or agar, existing min. wage, (Centre ya State ki fix ki hui), abhi hi floor wages se jyada hai, to wo shayni banke, kam nahi kar
         
         - Central/State govs----> Number of hours, ko fix karegi----> That constitute a normal working day. -----> Overtime karne pe, normal rate of wages se twice pagaar milegi. 
         
         - Wage, pay karna ka period lekin, employer hi decide karega, ---> Daily, weekly, fortnightly, ya monthly.

        Uttarakhand ne India ka Pehla Lichen park banaya hai----> Pithoragarh District ke Munsiyari Area me. 
        
            1) Ye 1.5 acres me faila hai---> 80 species of lichens hain. 
            
            2) Lichen---> Symbiotic relationship of Fungus and algae or Cyanobacterium. 
            
            3) Wasie, Lichen me, Akela Fungus hi lichen hota hai, lekin, Algae ko khush rakhne ke liye, Are dekho dekho lichen hai---> Lekin, lichen akela fungus hota hai, bechara Algae to bas, photosynthesis kar khana banati..
            
            4) Lichen SO2 se bade sensitive hote hai----> Jyada SO2 Concentration par Fungus bhaag jaata hai, rishta tod ke, or khali, Algae ALgae rah jaata hai. 
            
            5) SO2 se,  Algal partnet ki bhi maa chudti hai----> CHlorophyll destroy ho jata hai, or Photosynthesis inhibit ho jata hai.

                Economy Twin Deficits face karti hai, jab : 
                
                
                   1) Current account deficit or  Fiscal Deficit dono hote hain. 
                   
                   2) Ye dono often, ek dusre ko reinforce karte hain. 
                   
                   3) Current Account---> Flow of Goods, Services or Investments ko meausre karta hai. 
                   
                       - Iske Components :
                       
                            i) Trade of Goods
                            
                           ii) Service
                           
                          iii) Net Earnings on overseas investment and net transfer of payments over a period of time, such as remittances
                          
                      Matlab--> Current account = Trade Gap + Net Current Transfers + Net Income Abraod
                      
                      
                      
                    4) Ise, Boost karne ke liye, Exports badhao or, non-essential imports jaise gold, mobiles, electronics, ko curb karo 
                    
                    5) CGS data ke hisab se, FY 20 me India ka Fiscal Deficit 4.59 % of GDP ho gaya hai---> GoI ke target 3.8% se kaafi upar nikal gaya. 
                    
                    
                    
                    
                    
                
                
                
                
                
                
            Proportional Tax ---> Isem, Taxing authority, same rate of tax charge karti hai, taxpayer se, irrespective of income. 
              
                                  - Matlab, lower class, middle class or upper-class people, same rate of tax pay karte hain. 
                                  
                                  
                                  
                 - Kyunki, tax, flat rate par charge kiya jata hai, ----> Ise Flat Tax kehte hain. 
                 
               
               
               
           Progressive Tax ---> Jaise Jiase income badhti hai, Tax rate bhi badh jata hai. 
           
              - Is se redistribution objective ko achieve kiya jata hai. 
              
              - Chutiye log, is ke basis par, khub dolat kamate hain. 
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
              Demand Pull Inflation : 
              
                1) Jab, aggregate demand for a good or service, aggreagate supply se aage nikal jaati hai. 
                
                2) Jab, aggregate demand, productive capacity se jyada teji se badhti hai, tab, firms, prices badha deti hain. ---> Is se inflation hota hai. 
                
                3) Ye sabse, common cause hai, Inflation ka. 
                
                4) Causes : 
                
                     1) Growing Economy
                     
                     2) Lower Interst Rates
                     
                     3) Devaluation in the exchange rate---> Is se domestic demand badh, jaati hai, kyunki imports mahange ho jaate hain.  Is se, Cost-push inflation bhi aata hai, kyunki, imports mahange ho jaate hain. 
                     
                     4) Government Spending 
                     
                     5) More money in the system : Expansionary monetary policy.

            1) Infra Projects ko support karne ke liye, jo one-time or deferred grant di jaati hai.

            4) Infra projects me, externalitites bhi hoti hain, jo adequately capture nahi ho pati . 
            
            5) Ye un projects ke liye, di jaati hain, jo PPP se kiye jaate hain. 
            
            6) Ise, Min. of Finance admin. karti hai.

        Commercial Paper (CP)
        
        
           1) Ye ek , unsecured money markey instrument hai---> Jise Issue kiya jata hai, in the form of a promissory note. 
           
           2) Corporated, Primary Dealers(PDs) or All-India Financial Institutions(FIs) ---> Jinhe Permitt kiya gaya hai, short-erm resources raise karne ke liye, under the umbrella limit fixed by the RBI- 
           
               Ye saare eligible hai, CP issue karne ke liye. 
               
           3) Inhe, 7 days ki minimum or Max 1 saal ki maturities par isse kiya ja sakta hai
           
           4) Corporates, jo high rating enjoy karte hain, apne short term borrowings ko diversify kar sakte hain, using CPs. 
           
           5) Investors ko additional instrument mil jata hai. 
           
           6) Ise, typically large banks or corporations issue karte hain, short term financial obligations ko meet karne ke liye, jaise ki koi naya project fund karne ke liye. 
           
           
           7) Inhe, Rs 5 lakh ki denominations or multiples thereof me issue kiya jata hai.

     Marginal COst of Fund Based Lending Rate(MCLR) ----> Min. Interest rate of a bank, below which it cannot lend. 
     
     
       - Except kuch cases me, jab RBI allow karta hai. 
       
       - Ise RBI calculate karta hai, based on factors jaise : 
       
           a) Marginal cost of Funds
           
           b) Negative carry on account of CRR
           
           c) Operating Cost and Tenor Premium
         
           
       - Isne Base Rate system ko abolish kiya, jise 2010 me introduce kiya tha. 
       
       - matlab, 2016 ke baad se, saare rupee loans sanction kiye gaye hain, or jo credit limits renew ki gayi hain, MCLR ke basis pe===> Ye Internal Benchmark hai
       
       - Chahe, Fixed rate loan ho, ya floating, Sabko MCLR + Spread . 
       
       - Lekin, kuch type ke loans ko abhi bhi link nahi kiya gaya hai : 
       
           - 3 saal se jyada ke tenure ke fixed-rate loans
           
           - GoI dwara formulate ki gayi, special loans scheme
           
           - Banks ke depositors ko jo advances diye gaye hain, against their won deposits. 
           
           - Advances to bank's own employees. 
           
           
           
           
           
           
           
      Plasma -  4th state of Matter 
      
      
         1) Gas jaisa hai, lekin comprised of Positive ions and free electrons ---> With little or no overall electric charge
         
         2) Charged ions ki presence ki wajah se, Plasma highly electrically conductive hota hai, or kafi strongly respond karta hai, magnetic or electric fields ke.
         
         3) Plasma ki koi fixed shape or volume nahi hota, or wo solids/liquids se less dense hota hai. 
         
         4) Plasma, most common state hai matter ka, in Universe---> Comprising more than 99% of our visible universe. 
         
         5) Ye sub ne naturally milta hai,   Stars ki cores me,    Pulsars jo X-Ray beams emit karte hain or Supernovas me. 
         
         6) Earth par, Flames, Lightning or auroras me milta hai. 
         
         7) High Temp par gas ko heat karne se , gas ke atoms, ionize ho jate hain.

         Real Exchange Rate = Nominal Exchange rate * (Price of Domestic good/ Price of Foreign Good) 
         
         
            - RER se, kisi economy ke competetiveness ka idea hota hai. 
            
            - Is se pata chalta hai, ki jya, Goods or Services ke price, home me jyada hai, ya abroad. 
            
            - Agar domestic prices kam honge, to exports badhenge, or Trade surplus hoga. 
            
            
          - Jab RER equal ho do desho ka, to ham kehte hain ki Purchasing power parity hai.

         Monetary Policy COmmittee : 
         
            
             1) Ise, RBI Act, 1935 ke Secion 45ZB ke under banaya gaya hai. 
             
             2) Ye Benchmark interest rate fix karta hai India ki. 
             
             3) MPC ki meetings, saal me at least 4 baar hoti hai, or ye apne decisions publish karta hai, after such meeting. 
             
             4) Quorum--> Meeting ke liye---> 4 members--> Jinme se atleast, 1 Governor hoga, or iski absence me, Deputy GOvernor---> JO member hoga MPC ka. 
             
             5) Committee me 6 members honge---> 3 RBI ke officials, 3 external members, jinhe GoI nominate karegi----> Nominated for 4 years and are not eligible for re-appointment and shall not have completed 70 years of age. 
             
             6) Central Gov jo members appoint karti hai, unhe recommend karti hai, Search-cum-selection committee---> Jiska Chairman hota hai--> Cabinet Secy,  Member- RBI GOv etc
             
             7) Governor, RBI ----> Ex- OFficio chairman hai, is committee ka . 
             
             8) Majority decisions leti hai, jisme Gov ke pass casting vote hota hai. 
             
             9) Gov, RBI ke saath milkar, 5 saal me ek baar---> CPI ki terms me Inflation target decide karti hai. 
             
            10) Current Mandate hai----> 4% annual Inflation until March 31,2021 ----> Upper tolerace 6% and lowe tolerance 2%. 
            
            
            
            
            
         
         
        Ad Valorem or Specific Tax---> Dono hi indirect taxes hain. 
        
          1) Ad Valorem---> Jo price pe lagta hai---> Ex---> Luxory cars par 28% tax hai.  Matlab, agar 100 rs ki car hai, to 28 rupey tax lagega. 
          
          2) Sepcific tax---> Fixed amount of tax, based on quantity of units sold---> 1 car ka 5 rs, to agar 100 cars biki to 500 rs tax. Farq nahi padta, car, 5rs ki ho ya 5 Cr ki. 
          
          
          3) Ad Valorem wale ko ususally As a % express karte hain.   Jaise GST ek Ad valorem tax hai----> 5, 12, 18%. etc
          
          4) Specific wale ko ---> Jaise excise duty on petrol----> Specific sum pe---> Aadha litre par itna, 2 litre par itna, aisa. 
          
          
          
          Ad Valorem---> progressive hote hain. 
          
          Specific wale--> Regressive hote hain, ye aurato ko ghar se bahar nahi aane dete.

          1) Water - 56%
          
          2) Wind Erosion - 28%
          
          3) Overgrazing - 35%
          
          4) Clearing of vegetation - 7%
          
          5) Industrail Activity - 1%
         
         
         
         
         
 Human Methane Pollution ke main reasons : 
         
         
           1) Largest---> Production, Distribution and combustion of Fossil fuels ----> 33%
           
           2) Human methane emission ka ek important source hai----> Farm animals ----> 27% to inke paadne se aata hai
           
           3) Landfills or Wastes se---> 16% og human methane emissions
           
           4) Paddy fields :--> High moisture + Oxygen depletions + Ample Organic material---> Great envt for methane producing microbes that decompose the organic matter.

         Byssinosis --------> Ye bhi Lungs ki disease hai---> Cotton dust agar koi chutiya sungh le, ya fir kisi or tarah ke veggie fibre , jaise flax, hemp ya sisal, ko sungh le to
         
         
         Minamata ----------->  Severe mercury poisoning se neurological syndrome ho jata hai. 
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         Generally Sab tarah ke pyramids(of number, energy and biomass) Upright hote hain---> Matlab, producers jyada hote hain, number or Biomass me, than the herbivores and then comes carnivores and so on. 
         
         
           - Lekin, Sea me, jo Pyramid of Biomass hota hai---> Wo inverted hota hai----> Kyunki, Bade bade whale, shark type machhi log ka biomass kaafi jyada hota hai, nanhe se phytoplankton ke mukaable. 
           
          
          
          - Inverted pyramid of numbers bhi ho sakta hai kisi ecosystem me---> jab, Community me thode se producers ho, jinka bhayanak bada biomass ho, or ye, large number of smaller consumers ko support karte ho. 
          
          
          - Lekin, Pyramid of Energy hamesha upright hoti hai, kyunki sach kabhi jhoot nahi bolta.

           - Mycorrihzae---> Host plant ko Phosphorous or Nitrogen ke uptake me specially madad karte hain. 
           
           - Ye actually me podho ki roots par hote hain, or unka surface area badha dete hain.

        Phosphorous : 
        
        
          1) Rocks me hota hai, jaha se soil me jaata hai, jaha se plants me jaata hai, jaha se janwar kha lete hain. 
          
          2) Isnki tatti or mari hui lasho ko, Phosphate-solubilising bacteria decompose kar dete hain, jis se phosphorous release hota hai 
          
          3) Carbon ke jaise, Phosphorous koi Respiratory release nahi hota. 
          
               - Rainfall se bhi phosphorous ka inpur, carbon ke mukaable bohot hi kam hota hai. 
               
               - Envt or ORganisms ke beech, Phosphorous ka gaseous exchange to bilkil negligible hota hai, unlike Carbon.

      WESTERLIES :
      
         1) Permanent winds jo blow karti hain, Subtropical High Pressure Belts to Sub-polar low-pressure belts,  Dono Hemispheres me. 
         
         2) Inki General Direction hoti hai
         
                     Northern Hemisphere me----> South West to North East
                     
                     Southern Hemisphere me ---> North West to South East
                     
                     
         3) Lund na hone ki wajah se southern Westerlies, bohot hi dej gati prapt kar leti hain
         
             i) 40 se 50 Degrees ke beech ki westerlies ko----> Roaring forties kehte hain. 
             
            ii) 50 degrees wali ko Furious fifties kehte hain. 
            
           iii) 60 degree latiture pe milti hai, teri maa or Shrieking sixties.

       Earth Or Sun ke beech least distcance hoti hai, Komal Ke birthday ke 5 din pehle, yani 3 jaunary ko----> 147 million km. 
       
          - Kyunki, Komal Katty pery jitni hot hai, isliye, is distance ko Perihelion kehte hain. 
          
      
      Earth or Sun ke beech maximum distance hoti hai, USA ke Idependence day par, kyunki us din, Suraj dev bhi dharti ke kareeb nahi rehna chahte----> 152 million km
      
          - Is time Earth Aphelion me hoti hai. 
          
          
           Jis plane me earth ki orbit lie karti hai, us plane ko, Plane of Ecliptic kehte hain. 
           
              - Earth ka equator, is plane ke angle ke 23.5 degrees par inclined hota hai. 
              
              - Earth ki axis, us elciptic plane se 66.5 degrees ka angle banati hai, or us plane se agar koi perpendicular draw karein to us se 23.5 degrees par tilted hoti hai. 
              
              - Ye inclination responsible hota hai, Earth ke seasons par change.
              
          
       Solistice :-   Is time, Sun, equator se greatest distance par hota hai, or sun ki rays, vertically pad rahi hoti hai, either Tropic of Cancer ya Tropic of Capricorn par. 
       
       
          1) Summer Solistice aata hai, June 21/22 ko Northern Hemisphere me
           
                      Sun ki vertical rays, Tropic of Cancer par padti hain
                      
                        
          2) Winter Solstice : 21/22 December---> Sun ki Vertical Rays---> Tropic of Capricorn par pad rahi hoti hain. 
          
                      Ye Northern Hemisphere me winter season ka time hota hai. 
                      
                      Light ki duration, South ki taraf badhti hai.

       Aquiclude----> Rocks ki underground layer, jo sponge ki tarah kaam karti hai. 
       
                      - Isme, large amount of water hota hai, lekin, iske through paani pass nahi hota. 
                      
                      - Clay, bhi ek tarah ki aquiclude hai----> Iske pore spaces itne chote hote hain, ki khub saara paani absorb to kar lete hain, lein, apne through pane ke jaane ko permit nahi karta--impermiable. 
                      
                      - Granite, aquiclude nahi hai.

    Himalayas me earthquake aate rehte hain kyunk :
       
      1) Himalayas Tectonically active hai
       
      2) Ye mostly, sedimentary rocks se bane hain, and unconsolidated and semi-consolidated deposits. 
      
      3) Inke slopes kaafi steep hote hain. 
      
      
      Himalayas ke comparisson me, Nilgiris, tectonically Stable hain, or very hard rocks se bane hain----> Lekin, debris avalanches or Landslides aate rehte hain yahan :
      
         1) Steep slopes
         
         2) Temperature changes ki wajas se kutte ki tarah Mechanical Weathering hui hai
         
         3) Bohot thode se time me, bhayanak heavy rainfall aa jaata hai.

                       Ye Rhone Valley se hoke nikalti hai. 
                       
                       Funneling Effect ki wajah se iski velocity bhayanak badh jaati hai. 
                       
                       Ye bohot thandi, or dry hoti hai. 
                       
                       Ye south france me blizzards laati hai, jis se waha ke logo ke aand jam jaate hain. 
         
         
         
         
         
         Temperate zone me, Warm front ke cold front ke upar chadh jaane se jo baarish aati hai, wo Drizzle ki form me hoti hai-----> Widespread and of long duration. 
         
         
           Or, Cold Fronts ki wajah se jo Baarish hoti hai, wo ---> Thunder ka roop dharan karti hai, or kaafi short duration ki hoti hai. 
         
         
         
         
         
         
      Valley Inversion :---> 
      
      
              Mountainous Valleys me---> Due to radiation and vertical movement of air. 
              
                                         Valley ke upper part se, jo thandi or bhaari bharkam hawa aati hai, wo valley ke lower part wali, garm or halki hawa ko upar chaal deti hai. 
                                         
                                         Is wajah se valley floor par thandi hawa hoti hai, or uske upar garam hawa-----> Ise temperature inversion kehte hain. 
                                         
                                         Iski wajah se valley me severe frost aate hain----> Jis se fruit orchards or veggie and agri crops ki maa chud jaati hai. ---> Same time pe, upper parts of valley frost free rehte hain. 
                                         
                                         Is wajah se valley ke floors par, koi chutiya hi ghar banata hai, or saare settlements, upar hi bane hote hain.

                2) Isliye, Guinea coastal area me ise, Doctor winds kehte hain. --->> Kyunki iske aane se waha ka sada hua, humid climate, ekdam mast ho jaata hai.

        Decomposition ke liye, favourable conditions : 
        
           1) Moisture :---> Intermeditate.  Kyunki, High moisture me, gas exchange ruk jata hai, or Anaerobic conditions ban jaati hain, or Low Moisture me, pani ki kami se  microbial metabolism dheema pad jaata hai. 
           
           2) Oxyegen:----> High oxygen is good, Lack of oxygen--> Hypoxic conditions--> Organisms multiply nahi ho paate. 
           
           3) Agar food, Nitrogen, or sugar jaise water soluble substance me high to decomposition aasaani se ho jayega, or agar, lignin or chitin jaise se rich hai, to wait karte rah jaoge bachhuu 
           
           4) Cool temperatures me microorganisms ke aand jam jaate hain, or decomposition inhibit ho jaata hai. 
           
           5) Strong acidic soils me, Rhizobia type bacteria, dam tod dete hain..

        P-Waves---> Ye Sound ki tarah aage piche hoke chalti hai, wave direction ke parallel----> Is wajah se ye, stretching or squeezing karti hain.   Ye teeno, Gas Liquid or Solid se pass ho jati hai. 
        
        S-Waves---> Ye sine waves ki tarah, upar neeche, yani, wave direction ke perpendicular chalit hai----> Is wajah se ye crusts or troughs banati hain.   Ye bas, Solid se pass ho sakti hain. 
        
        
        P or S lekin, dono body waves hoti hain.   Ye jab, Surface se interact karti hain, to ek nayi tarah ki wave create hoti hain----> Surface waves---> Ye sabse jyada gand marti hain. 
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        Volcanic Landforms : 
        
        
           1) Batholiths :---> Dome-Shaped Granite bodies---> Magma chambers ke cooled portion se banti hain. ---> Jab denudation se iske upar ka surface hat jata hai, to ye dikhai deta hai.  Bada area cover karti hai. 
           
           
           2) Dykes :---> Sheets hoti hai, layers me.   Rocks ke jo weak zones hote hain, unme dyke ghus jaati hai.  Ye, khadi hoti hain.     Leti hui dike ko Sill kehte hain. 
           
           
           3) Lapolith :---> Jab lava upwards move karta hai, to uska thoda portion horizontal bhi chala jata hai, jab use koi kamjor plane milta hai.  Agar, wo ek Chammach ki shape lele, to use, laplith kehte hain. 
           
           
           4) Phacolith :---> Magma Chambers se source leti hui, Syncline ke base pe, ya anticline ke top pe bana ye ajeeb sa wavy mass, Phacolith kahalata hai.

        Crust or Mantle ke beech, Mohorovicic Discountinuity hoti hai. 
        
           Moho'd discontinuity se leke, neeche ke 2900 km tak, Mantle hoti hai. 
           
            Mantle ke upper potion ko Asthenosphere kehte hain.    'Astheno' bole to weak. 
            
            - Asthenosphere 400 km tak hota hai. 
            
            - Crust or Uppermost part of mantle ko lithosphere kehte hain. 
            
            
            
           2900km par mantle ki boundry hoti hai, or uske baad core start ho jaati hai.   Is boundry ko--> Gutenberg disconitinuity kehte hain. 
           
             Outer core, liquid state me hoti hai, or inner core, Solid state me. 
             
             Core bohot hi bhaari bharkam, material se bani hoti hai-----> Mostly, Nickle and Iron. ---> isiliye, ise Nife layer bhi kehte hain. 
             
               Core bhi saali, 2 layers me hoti hai---> Inner core solid hoti, or outer wali Liquid state me(or semi-liquid) state me. 
               
                - Upper or Lower core ke beech ki discontinuity ko Lehmann discontinuity kehte hain.

      Sun or Moon, dono milke Earth pe tides laate hain. 
      
      
        - Moon ka jyada role hota hai, lekin sun bhi kam nahi hai. 
        
        - Jab sun , moon or earth algned hote hain( at the time of new or full moon) ---> Solar tide has an additive effect on the lunar tide---> Extra high high tides and very low low tides=== > Yahi hai, Spring tides. 
        
        - 1 hafte baad, Sun or Moon, right angle par hote hain, ek dusre ke--> Solar tide, partially cancels out lunar tide---> Moderate tides banti hain ==== > Neap tides. 
        
        - Har lunar month--> 2 sets of spring tides and 2 sets of neap tides occur.

       Article 110 ke hisab se Money Bill hai, agar usme bas wo provisions hai jo deal karte hain :
       
          1) Koi bhi tax--> Impose, abolsih, Remit, ya alter karne ke liye            								  [Tax- Impose, abolish, alter ya remit karna]
          
          2) Union Gov ke karje chakne ke regulation ko                                                                                            [Centre ke karje]
          
          3) Consolidated ya Contigency Fund of India, ki custody se related, Ya in dono funds me paisa daalne, ya withdraw karne se related.      [CFI- Custody, paisa dalna, Paisa nikalna]
          
          4) Consolidated Fund of India se, money appropriate karna.      	                                                                   [CFI se appropriation] 
        
          5) CFI par koi expenditure charged hai, aisa declare karna. Ya aise kisi expenditure ki amount badhana.                                   [CFI ke charged expenditure]4
          
          6) Receipt of money on account of CFI or the Public Account of India, or the custody or issue of such money, or the audit of accounts of Union or of a State.
          
          7) Baaki saare matters jo incidental hai, inme se kisi bhi matters par. 
          
          
          
       Article 110 ke hisab se, Koi bill, Money bIll nahi hai agar :
       
         1) Agar, us se Fines ya koi or pecuniary penalties impose ki jaa rahi hai. 
         
         2) Koi service render karne ke liye, ya koi licenses ke liye, fee demand ya pay karne se related
         
         3) Local Authority/body ke kisi local kaam ke liye, lagaye gaye kisi tax ko impose, abolish, remit, alter ya regulate karne se related.

      CROPPING INTENSITY :- Bole, to Ek hi agri year, me , same field se, number of crops ugana. 
      
                           = (Gross Cropped Area / Net Sown area) * 100
      
      
          - Achi croppeing pratice hoti hai--> Crop Rotation ---> Different crops, diff proportions me , different nutrients absorb karti hain, different soil strata se 
          
          - Ex :- Cereals grow karne se pehle, kuch oilseeds ugao, jis se wo Atmospheric nitrogen ko soil me fix kar denge---> Jise fir cereals absorb kar payenge. 
          
          - Similar--> Mixed Cropping ---> Wheat or Barley,  Ya fir, Wheat or Gram ko ek saath ugate hain, to maintain balance of consumption between different nutrients. 
          
          - Relay cropping :- Ek saath un crops ko ugana, jinke different nurturing periods ho, or unhe ek baad ek harvest karna---> ex :- Highly fertiliser intensive Sugarcane or Tobacco ke baad cereals ko ugana, taki residual nutrients ko utilise kiya ja sake.

              RT-PCR : 
              
                   Reverse Transcription Polymerase Chain Reaction 
                   
                     1) Ye Covid-19 Sars virus ko identify karne ke liye. 
                     
                     2) Naak me rui daal ke Virus ke nucleic acid ko detect karte hain. 
                     
                     3) Chutiyaap : 
                     
                          a) Temperature ka randi rona---> 2 alag alag temperatures chahiye---> Iske liye, Mahnage Thermal Cycler or Real time PCR machines chahiye. 
                          
                          b) Deep freezer chahiye, sample ko store karne ke liye. 
                          
                          c) Use karne ke liye, extensive treaining deni padti hai 
                          
                          d) 95% sppecificity and sensitivity---> Matlab false negative bhi aa jaate hain. 
                          
                          e) 10 ghante lagte hain, result dikhane me.   Remote areas me to or bhi jyada
                          
                          
                          
              RT- LAMP :
               
                  Reverse Transcription Loop Mediated isothermal amplifiation
                  
                   1) ye bhi SARS-CoV-2 ko detect karne ke liye, use ho raha hai India me
                   
                   2) Isme RNA se pehle cDNA banate hain, by ususal Reverse transcription ----> Fir DNA ko amplify karte hain by LAMP technology. 
                   
                   3) ADvantages: 
                   
                         a) Cost-effective hai----> Airport wagarh par, mobile units wagarh me setup kiya ja sakta hai. 
                         
                         b) Ye 65 Degrees par karwaya jaata hai----> DNA amplification ko constant temperature par karwaya jaata hai---> Isliye, expansive Thermal Cycler nahi chahiye hota hai. 
                         
                         c) Final DNA amplify hokar aata hai jo, wo kaafi jyada hota hai, isliye, simple color reaction se hi kaam chal jaata hai---> Koi mahangi Real time PCR machine nahi chahiye
                         
                         d) Reagents ko 4 degreees par store karna hota hai, Yaani lalu se fridge me hi rakh lo chahe to, RT-PCR wale ko -20 degrees me. 
                         
                         e) Or sabse mast baat--> Bas 30 minutes me result aa jaata hai---> or agar positive ho to saala bas 10 minutes me .
                         
                         
                         
                         
                         
     IN-SITU BIO-Remeditation Techniques : 
             
                1) BIOVENTING :- Contaminated soil me, kue khod ke, Air or nutrients supply karo---> Taaki waha indegenous bacteria grow ho sake. 
                
                               - Ise simple Hydrocarbons ke liye use kiya jata hai. 
                               
                               - Agar, contamination surface ke kaafi neeche ho, to bhi use kiya ja sakt hai. 
                               
                               
                2) BioSPARGING :- Khub pressure me, Water Table ke neeche, Air Inject karo, taaki groundwater oxygen concentration badh sake. 
                
                                - Is se contaminants jis rate me biological degradation karte hain, usa rate badh jata hai
                                
                                
                3) Bioslurping :- Bioventing + Vaccum-enhanced free product recovery ki madad se---> 2 seperate contaminant media ko address kiya jata hai. 
                
                                - Bioventing---> Stimulates aerobic bioremediation of Hydrocarbon-contaminated soils. 
                                
                                - Vaccum-Enhanced......Recovery se---> Water table se capillary action ki madad se groundwater contaminants extract kar lete hain. 
                                
                                
                4) BioAugmentaion :- Contaminated sites me micro-organisms ko import kiya jata hai, to enhance the degradation process. 
                
                    
                         
      EX-SITU Bioremediation : 
      
      
                     1) Landfarming : Contaminated soil ko excavate kare, ek prepared bed par spreak kar dete hain or periodically till karte hain. 
                     
                                     - Goal = Stimulate Indigenous biodegradative microorganisms
                                     
                                     - Facilitate aerobic degradation of contaminants. 
                                     
                    2) Biopiles : Hybrid of landfarming and composting.---- Petroleum se contamination par use kiya jata hai
                    
                    3) Bioreactors :- Contaminated solid material ko engineered conatinment system ke through process kiya jata hai.

          Earth Ki Molten COre :
          
              1) Is molten core ki wajah se hi Earth par ek Magnetic field hai.

              3) Is wajah se Earth ki magnetic field bhi khatam ho jayegi.

              5) Earth ke radioactive species--> Uranium-235 and 238,  Thorium-232  and Potassium-40 ---> Lithophilic a.k.a rock loving hote hain. 
              
                      - Ye aasani se Oxygen ke saath Bond bana lete hain. 
                      
                      - Is wajah se ye upar aa jaate hain or Crust me milte hain. Nahi to ye bhi differention ke time, Iron ki tarah Core me chalye gaye hote, or hame kabhi Nukes mil hi naa paate.

      DRAINAGE PATTERNS :
      
         1) Dendritic :-  
         
                          - Jab, terrain ke slope ko follow kare river
                          
                          - Stream, apni tributaries ke saath, Ped ki branches jaisi lagti hai. 
                          
                          - Jyadatar rivers of Indo-Gangetic Plains---> Dendritic Type
                          
           
           
         2) Trllis :- 
         
                           - Jab, tributaries, Rivers se right angles pe aakar jude. 
                           
                           - Ye develop hota hai, jab har or soft rocks, parallel ho ek dusre ke. 
                           
                           - Trellis me, river ek net-like system form karti hai. 
                           
                           - Tributaries, roughly flow parallel to each other. 
                           
                           - Chotanagpur plateau ke purane fold mountains me trellis pattern wale drainage dekhne ko milta hai. 
                           
         
         
         
         3) Rectangular :- 
         
                            -  Nashedi Trellis---> more irregular and tributaries are not as long, nor parallel as in trellis drainage. 
                            
                            - Strongly jointed rocky terrain me dikhta hia. 
                            
                            - Vindhyan Mountains of India 
                            
                            
         4) Radial Pattern :- 
         
                               - Central Peak or dome-like structure se jab, different directions me stream flow karti hai. 
                               
                               - Amarkantak Mountain se jo nadiya nikatli hai. 
                               
                               - Ex :- Rivers like, narmada, Son and Mahanadi, orginiating from Amarkantak hills flow in different directions. 
                               
                               - Ye same pattern, Girnar hills (Kathiawar, Gujrat) and Mikir Hills of Assam  me dikhta hai.

       Bioremediation Techs : 
       
         1) Oilzapper :-  5 different bacterial strains ka ek cocktail hai--> That are immobilized and mixed with a carrier material(Powdered corncob).
         
                        - Feeds on Hyrocarbons compounds present in crude oil and oily sludge. 
                        
                        - COnverts HCs into Harmless CO2 and Water. 
                        
         2) Oilivorous-S --> Thoda sa different hai, Oilzapper se, kyunki isme ek extra bacterial strain hoti hai, jis se ye jyada effective ho jata hai, un sludge ke against, jime high sulfur content hota hai. 
         
              - Dono, 1) and 2) ko in-situ use kiya ja sakta hai---> Eliminating the need to transfer, large quantitites of contaminated waste from the site.

         Zones of Lakes and Ponds : 
         
            1) Littoral ZOne :-  Topmost zone near the shore of a lake or pond is Littoral Zone. 
            
                                 Ye zone warmest hota hai---> Since it is shallow and absorb more of sun's heat. 
                                 
                                 Ye fairly diverse community ko sustain kar sakta hai----> Several species of Algae(Like diatoms), rooted and floating aquatic plants, Grazing snails, Clams, Insects, Crustaceans, fishes etc
                                 
                                 
         
         
            2) Limnetic Zone :-  Near-Surface, open water surrounded by Littoral zone
            
                                 Ye open water area hota hai, jaha light does not penetrate to the bottom. 
                                 
                                 Ye bhi, littoral zone ki tarah, well lighted hota hai---> Dominated by Plankton--> Both Phytoplankton and Zooplantkton
                                 
                                 Yaha bohot tarah ke freshwater machii bhi milti hai. 
                                 
                                          
            3) Profundal Zone :-  Lake/Pond ka deep water
            
                                  Ye zone,kaafi cold or dense hota hai, baaki dono se. 
                                  
                                  Yaha bohot hi thodi light pahonchti hai. 
                                  
                                  Yaha ka fauna heterotrophs hota hai, jo mare hue organisms ko khata hai, and use oxygen for cellular respiration.

      National Park :---> Ye area hota hai, jo strictly reserved hota hai, Wildlife ke betterment ke liye---> Yaha Human activities jaise, Forestry, Grazing ya Cultivation are not permitted. 
      
                          Ex:- Jim Corbett National Park, Sunderbans etc
                          
                          
      Wildlife Sanctuary :----> Wildlife animals or Plant species ke conservation ke liye ye protected area reserved hota hai. 
      
                                - Lekin, Yaha Human activities jaise, Harvesting or timber collection of minor forest products and Private ownership rights are allowed.. 
                                
                           Ex: Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary
                           
       Biosphere Reserve :----> Special area of Land ya Coastal Environment---> jaha multiple uses of land is permitted by dividing it into certain zones. 
       
                                - Natural or Core zone---> Consists of an undisturbed and legally protected ecosystem. 
                                
                                - Buffer zone---> Ye core zone ko surround karta hai---> Managed to accomodate a greater variety of resource use strategies. 
                                
                                - Transition Zone---> Biosphere reserve ka outermost part------> Local people or Mgmt ke beech, an area of active cooperation.
