            1) Alpha Diversity -----> Ek community ke under, small scale ya local scale par, specied diversity kitni hai   (Generally local bole to---> Size of 1 ecosystem)
            
                                      Jab hum casually, diversity ki baat karte hain, to yahi alpha diversity ki baat kar rahe hote hain. 
                                      
                                      
            2) Beta Diversity-------> 2 seperate entities, jo clearly divided hain, nadi ya pahad jaise geographical barrier me, un dono ke species diversity  ko describe karne ke liye. 
            
            3) Gamma Diversity------> Biome ke andar jab, diversity ko study kare.----> jaha bohot saare ecosystems ke beech, diversity ko study kiya jaye. 
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            MAJOR MASS EXTINCTIONS : 
            
            
               1) Ordovician- Silurain extinction ---> 444 million years ago---> South pole koi chutiye glacier ne saara paani kheench liya, or samundar ke upar level ke prani mar gaye, bhen ke lode
               
               2) Late Devonian Extinction- 350 million years ago-----------> Ocean ka oxygen level kam ho gaya or Squid or octopus ke dada saans liye bina mar gaye, bhen ke lode. 
               
               3) Permian Triassic extinction - 250 million years ago-------> Siberain traps se lava nikla or jal gaye bhen ke lode. 
               
               4) Triassic-Jurassic Extinction- 200 million years ago-------> Central Pangea se greenhouse gases nikli, or greenhouse effect ki wajah se mar haye mahan ke lode. 
               
               5) Cretaceous-Paleogene extinction- 66 million years ago-----> Asteroid aake takraya or lode lag gaye.

    a==
    
       
        
        
        FISCAL DRAG ----> jab Inflation ya Income growth ki wajah se Taxpayers, Higher tax bracket me pahonch jayein. 
        
                          Is se, bina tax rates badhaye, hi Govt. ki tax revenue badh jaati hai. 
                          
                          Lekin is se --> Consumer spending or aggregate demand bhi kam ho jaati hai(Kyuni bechara tax me hi sab luta dega to kharchega kya) ----> which leads to delationary policies or drag, on the economy. 
                          
                          Ye un desho me hota hai, jaha, progressive taxes hote hain. 
                          
                          Lekin, kuch chutiye economists, ise acha mante hain, kyunki is se economy overheat hone se bach jaati hai. 
                          
                          
                          
                          
                          
                          
                          
                          
             Liquidity Trap : 
             
              
                  1) Ye ek situation hai jisme, Money supply badhane par bhi, Interest rate or income nahi padhte, or economic growth stimulate nahi ho pati. 
                  
                  2) Ye ek extreme effect hai, monetary policy ka. 
                  
                  3) General Public ki Deflation ya war, se gand fat jaata hai, or unke haath jo bhi paisa aata hai use, hold karke rakhne lagte hain. 
                  
                  4) Is case me, Open Market Operations ke through Monetary policy ka lund farq nahi padta hai, Interest rate or level of income par. 
                  
                             
                          
                          
                          
           INFLATIONARY GAP : 
           
               1) Current  real GDP level, kitna kam us GDP level se, jab economy operate kar raha hoga at full employment. 
               
               2) Gap Inflationary tab hoga, jab, Current real GDP level, jyada ho, Potential GDP se. 
               
               3) Gap exist karta hai, jab demands for goods and services exceeds productions due to factors such as higher level of overall employment, Increased trade or Increased govt expenditure. 
               
               4) Isliye, Govt employees ki salary badhane se, or MSP badhane se, Govt Expenditure badhega---> Economy me jyada demand create hogi----> Inflationary gap or fool jayega. 
               
               5) Inflationary Gap kam karne ke liye : 
               
                     a) Govt spending kam karo
                     
                     b) Tax rate badha do
                     
                     c) Interest rate badha do
                     
                     d) Transfer payments kam kardo
                     
                     e) Bonds or securities issue karo

            Transfer Payment : one way payment---> Kisi person/organisation ko---> which has given/exchanged no goods or services for it. 
            
                               - Generally, Sarakar, Social Programmes ke through logo ko jo paisa deti hai, use Transfer payments kehte hain. 
                               
                               - MGNERGA worker, gaddhe khod ta hai, isliye, use milne wale payment ko Transfer payment nahi kah sakte, even though hamara man to bohot karta hai, sach bolne ka. 
                               
                               - PM kisan Yojna ke under milne wali, subsidy ---> haan ye hai transfer payment
                               
                               - Old age pension--> Ye bhi transfer payment hai.               
                          
                          
             
             
          Labour FOrce Participation Rate ----->  Labour Force/ working age population
          
              - Working age population---> 15 se 64 saal ke log. 
              
              
          Woker Population Ratio :---> Total population me se Employed persons ka % kitna hai. 
          
          
          Unemployment Rate(UR) :----> Labour force me se kitne berojgaar hai---< Mujhe isme gina jayega.        
             
                     
                          
                          
        
        
        
      Deflation----> Drop in prices of goods and services----> Aisa hone par, Inflation 0% ke neeche chala jaata hai. ----> Maane, -ve Growth rate indicated Deflation. 
      
      
      Disinflation---> Inflation hone ki rate kam hona---> Matlab inflation to hai, lekin short term me, inflation rate has reduced marginally. 
      
      
      Stagflation----> Inflation + Stagnant economic growth + High Unemployment rate
      
      Structural Inflation---> Supply bottlenect, Lack of infra, jaisi structural weaknesses ki wajah se jo inflation hota hai wo. -----> Ye mainly gareeb desho me hota hai. 
      
                               Lack of adequate supply responses or production to increase in demand is the cause of structural inflation.

         2005 me RBI or GoI ke beech ek MoU sign hua-----> RBI ke Sterilization operations ko aide karne ke liye. 
         
             - Ise Market Stabilisation Scheme kahte. 
             
             - RBI jab, foreign exchange market se, Foreign Currencies khareedti hai, to System me bhayanak excess liquidity aa jaati hai.----> Is excess liquidity ko withdraw karne ke liye MSS start kiya gaya tha. 
             
             - RBI foregin exchange khareedti hai, takki sala Paisa majboot na ho jaye, jis se hamare exports ki maa chud jayegi. 
             
             - Lekin, excess liquidity se Inflaiton aane ka dar rahta hai-----> Isi liye, RBI bonds bechti hai, or wo liquidity absorb kar leti hai. ======> Is process ko hi sterilization bolte hain. 
             
             - MSS ke under jo securities issue hoti-- Use Market Stabalizaion Scheme Bonds/Securities kehte hain. 
             
             - GoI iske liye RBI se paisa mangti hai or , T-Bills/Dated Securities issue karti hai---> Jinki madad se Market se liquidity absorb ki jaati hai.

        NAtional INCOME hota hai----> NET NATIONAL PRODUCT at factor cost. 
        
           
              Gross Domestic PRoduct se Net Factor income from abroad subtract karne se milta hai----> Gross National Product
              
              Gross national Product se depreciation subtract karne se milta hai----------------------> Net National Product---> Lekin isme Indirect taxes added hain, or subsidied ghati hui hain. 
              
              Isliye, Net National Product me se Indirect tax ghatakar, Subsidied add karne se milta hai------> National Income a.k.a  Net national Product at Factor cost. 
              
              
              
              NNP at Factor cost = National Income(NI) = NNP at Market prices- (Indirect taxes - Subsidies) = NNP at maket prices - Net indirect taxes (Net indirect taxes = Indirect taxes - Subsidies)

         FRBM act, 2003 ke baad se, RBI ko bilkul mana kar diya hai, ki BC, GoI jab apne T-Bills ka primary issuance kare, to tum paas bhi nahi dikhne chahiye. 
         
             Is se pehle, chodu RBI, paise leke pahonch jaati thi, GoI ke paas, ki bhai ek le, croro rupey, or mujhe T-Bills dede---> Ise Monetisation of Deficit kehte the, kyunki sarkar isa, apne deficit pura karne ke liye karti thi. 
             
              Ab, RBI bas Secondary market me operate karti hai, through OMO route---> Open Market operations--->  GoI primary market me bonds issue karti hai, or RBI secondary market se equivalent ammount ke G-Bonds khareed leti hai----> Ise, Indirect monetisation of deficit kehte hain.   Ye bhi ek kutti cheez hai, par kyaa karein.

    Indian== Patent Act, 1970
    
         - Main focus---> Desh ke gareeb logo ko, lower rates me medicines ka greater access ho.
         
         - 1970 act ke hisab se, Process patents diye jaate hain, naa ki product patents. 
         
         - Process patents se bas technology ke respect me protection milti hai, and the process/Method of manufacture and not the absolute protection to the product. 
         
         - Iska matlab, India me individual drugs ko nahi balki, us drug ke manufacture ki process ko patent milta hai. 
         
         - Iska matlab, reverse engineering se, Indian drug companies, same drug ko manufacture kar sakti hain. 
         
         - Poduct patents se, product ko absolute protection milti hai, jo India me nahi hota . 
         
         - Lekin, kyunki inida ko WTO ka member ban na tha, or TRIPS se comply karna tha, isliye, India ko Process or Product, dono ko prtection deni padi.

          Essential Commoditites Act, 1955 -
          
              1) Abhi bas, Extraordinary price rise, War, famine and natural calamity of a severe nature ke time hi, agriculture foodstuff par regulations laga sakte hain. 
              
              2) Stock limit re realted koi bhi action, price rise par based hoga. 
              
              3) Agar horticulture produce me 100% price badh gaya hai, or non-perishable agri foodstuff Ke retail price me 50% increment hua hai. 
              
              4) ECA,1955 ke basis pe govt, control kar sakti hai, Production, supply, commodity ka distribution and impose a stock limit. 
              
              5) Kyunki, is act ka aim, production ko control karna hai, is wajah se , is se producer ke profit par koi farq nahi padta. 
              
              6) Act me "Essential commodities" ki koi definition nahi di gayi hai. 
              
              7) Central Gov ko power hai, "schedule" se ek commodity ko add or remove kiya jaa sakta hai. 
              
              8) Centre, State gov ke saath milke, public interest me kisi, item ko essential declare kar sakta hai. 
              
              9) Presently "Schedule" me 9 commodities aati hai----> Drugs, Fertilisers, Inorganic ya organic ya mixed, Foodstuffs, Edible oils, Hank yarn, perto products, raw jute, Jute textiles, food crops ke liye seeds. 
              
             10) Abhi latst add kiye hain---> Face Masks or Hand sanitizers ----> Jinhe Covid-19 ke outbreak ke time, declare kiya gaya tha.

      COST-PUSH INFLATION: 
      
         1) Cost of wages or raw materials ke cost, badhne se jo inflation aata hai. 
         
         2) Higher cost of production se aggregate supply(amount of total production), kam ho sakti hai.
         
         3) Kyunki, demand same rehta hai, isliye, Price increases from production are passed onto consumers creating, cost-push inflation. 
         
         4) Cost-push inflation hota hai, jab, Supply cost badhta hai, or supply levels gir jaate hain.  Dono se hi prices badh jayenge, as long as demand remains same. 
         
         5) Labour, Raw materials ya capital goods me shortages ya cost increase se, cost-push inflation aata hai. 
         
         6) Ye bas tabhi aa sakta hai, jab demand relatively inelastic ho. 
         
              - Inelastic demand bole to---> Jaise, Cocaine wagarh ki hoti hai----> Matlab, price badhne par bhi log, chutiyo ki tarah khareed te hain. 
              
              - Iske ulat, Elastic demand hoti hai---> Jab log, higher price pay karne se mana kar de. 
                    - WO yaa to kam khareed dari karte hain, ya fir wo slightly different product ko switch kar dete hain.

       CPI vs GDP Deflator : 
       
          1) CPI me bas ek basket of commodities ke hi prices dekhe jaate hain, lekin, GDP deflator me sab Products or Services aa jaati hain. 
          
          2) CPI includes, prices of goods consumed by the representative consumer, hence it includes prices of imported goods.    
           
             GDP deflator does not include, prices of imported goods. 
             
          3) CPI me weights constant hote hain, lekin, GDP me har good ke production level ke hisab se wo differ karte hain. 
          
         
      GDP calculations ke liye Base year hai--> 2011-12 or CPI calculations ke liye hai 2012.    
         
         
        HDI measure karne ke liye ye criterias use kiye jaate hain : 
        
           1) Life Expectancy at birth 
           
           2) Mean years of schooling for adults aged 25 years and more. 
           
           3) Expected years of schooling for children of school entering age. 
           
           4) Gross National Income per capita

    Maize : 
    
         1) Ye wo table chair wala maize nahi hai, balki wo cereal crop hai, jo India me Paddy or Wheat ke baad, 3rd most ugai jaane wali cereal crop hai. 
         
         2) Advantages
              
                 i) Ye ek climate resiliatn crop hai--> Matlab, 20-30 saalo baad India ke saare log, Table chair wala maize nahi, balki, Crop wala Maize kha rahe honge. 
                 
                ii) Ise, murgio ko khilya jaa sakta hai,   Gaaye-bhaise bhi khaa lete hain,    or Industrial sector me bhi log khaa l....Nahi chode, iski waha bhi koi feasibility hai
                
               iii) Farmer income badhaane me kaam aati hai
               
                iv) Iska C4 plant mechanism hota hai---> Matlab ye dryland farming ke liye, apporopriate hai, BC ye to drought conditions me bhi ug jaati hai, High temp ka ispe lund farq nahi padta or Co2 ho na to bhi. 
                
                 v) Per hectare yield bhi kaafi achii hai. 
                 
                vi) Day neutral crop hone ki wajah se ye har season me ugayi jaa sakti hai. 
   
    
    
       
         C3 and C4 plants : 
          
             c3 plants wo hote hain, jinme, photorespiration kam karne ke liye, photosynthetic adaptations nahi hue hote. 
             
                - Ye Carbon fixation ka wahi sada gala method use karte hain---> Fixaion of Carbon dioxide by Rubisco---> Is se 3-carbon wala compound produce hota hai  ==> 3-PGA
                
                - 85% of the plant species, C3 type hote hain---> Rice, Wheat, Soybeans or saare ke saare ped. 
                
                
              C4 plants wo hote hain, jinme light-dependent reactions or Calivin Cycle, physically seperated hoti hai. 
              
                      - Light-dependent reaction mesophyll cells me hoti hai
                      
                      - Calvin cycle, ek special cell me hoti hai, jo leaf veins ke around hota hai. 
                      
                      - Bas 3% vascualar plants, hi C4 pathway ka use kar paate hain ====> Sugarcane, Corn or kuch tarah ke crabgrass. 
                      
                      - Ye un habitats me milte hain, jo garam hote hain, lekin thande ilaako me kam milte hain. 
                      
                      - In cells ko bundle-sheeth cells kehte hain.

      Hybrid Annuity Model(HAM) : 
      
           1) BOT Annuity or EPC models ka mixture hai. 
           
           2) Phele 5 saal me, Government, project cost ka 40% contribute karegi---> Through annual payment (annuity)
           
           3) Baaki ki payment, developer ki performance ke basis pe hogi. 
           
           4) Matlab, 40% diye jayenge, through 5 equal payments.    Matlab, construction ke liye, developer ko baaki ka amount khudse jugaadna padega.    Ye baaki, 60%, equity ya loans ki form me laata hai. 
           
           5) Or remaining 60% is paid as variable annuity, after completion of the project, depending upon the value of the asset created. 
    
           6) Koi Toll nahi lagane diya jayega developer ko. 
           
           7) Revenue collection, NHAI karegi. 
           
           8) Fayda ye hai, ki, Developer ko enough liquidity mil jaati hai, or Financial Risk is shared by the government. 
   
           9) Govt, ise stalled projects me use karne ka soch rahi hai. 
   
   
   
   
   
     Energy ko Commercial or Non-commercial me bhi classify kiya jaata hai. 
     
        i) Commercial wo hai, jo market me  mil jaye, for a definite price ---> Ex- Electricity, Coal, Refined petroleum products
        
       ii) Non-Commercial, wo hai jo market me lene jao, to log dande se mare--> Firewood, Cattle dung, Agri waste ---> Inhe traditionally gather karte hain
       
         
         India me, Commercial energy consumption makes up, 74% of the total energy consumed. 
           
                    - Coal--> 54%
                    
                    - Oil --> 32%
                    
                    - Natural Gas --> 10%
                    
                    - Hydro energy --> 2%

     CURRENCY SWAP KE FAYDE : 
     
             1) To hedge exposure to exchange rate risk
             
             2) To speculate on the direction of a currency
             
             3) Reduce the cost of borrowing in a foreign currency
             
                
                     Usually, Financial instis, involved hote hain, in currency swaps me, khudke behalf pe, ya kisi non-financial corporation ke behalf pe. 
                     
                     Swap me, 2 parties, equivalent amount of money ka exchange karti hai, but in different currencies. 
                     
                     Essentially, ek dusre ko money loan de rahi hoti hain.
                     
                     Will repay the amount at a specified date and exchange rate.

Genetically Modified Crops : 


   - 1990s me German Scientists ne ek Biofortified crop variety banai thi ---> Golden Rice
   
   - Rice me 2 beta-carotene biosynthesis genes daal diye the
   
        i) psy--> Phyotene synthase--> Daffodil se nikaalke----> Ye Maize ki ek variety hai
        
       ii) crtl-> Ek soil me milne wale bacteria- Erwina uredovora



    Beta-Carotene + Carotenoids ko hi Pro-Vitamins kehte hain. 
    
    
    
    Isliye, Golden Rice khane se bhayank Vitamin A milta hai. -----> Vitamin A ki deficiency hi leading cause of blindness hota hai, children me. + Isi ki kami ki wajah se Measles jaise infectious diseases hote hain.

 3D Bioprinting 
 
    - Sabse pehle model ka structure tayyar karte hain, jise fir bio-ink ki madad se layer by layer, recreate kiya jata hai. 
     
    - Starting model, CT ya MRI scan se,  Coumputer-Generated Design (CAD) program se ye BC 4chan ke kisi thread me kisi chode ne share ki hui file se, bhi liye ja sakte hain. 
    
    - 3D model file ko fir ek, Slicer naam ke computer programme me daalte hain----> Jo model ko geometry ko analyse karta hai, or Thin layers generate karta hai(Slices)---> Jinhe vertically stacked karne par, Original Model ki shape tayyar ho jaati hai. 
         
           Ex : Cura and Slic3r---> Ye generally use hote hain 3D printing me.      Allevi bioprint Software bhi hai ek (Trade mark)
           
           
    - Slice hone ke baad, ek g-code file develop hoti hai, jise fir seedha 3D bioprinter me bhej diya jata hai printing ke liye. 




   
   
   Nano-Micelles : 
   
       - Ye ultramicroscopic(10-100 nm) ke structures hote hain, jinhe diseases ke treatment me kaam me liya jaata hai. 
       
       - Inme ek Hydrophilic outer shell hoti hai,    or ek Hydrobhobic exterior----> Jiski madad se ye, Poorly water-soluble drugs ko deliver karwa sakte hain, or drug molecules ko protect bhi kar sakte hain. 
       
       - Specially kaam aate hain, Protein or Peptide delivery me .
       
       - Lekin tissues me ghuste hi micelles, disintegrate ho jaate hain, rapidly. 
 
       - Cancer treatment me kaam aa sakte hain----> OVercoming drug resistance, improving anti-cancer drug efficacy and reducing drug toxicity.

     Nobel Gases ke uses : 
     
         1)  Helium---> Low solubility---> Blood me dissolve nahi hoti---> Bubbles form nahi hote, decompression ke time---> Isliye, Deep-sea divers use karte hain, Nitrogen maa chod deti hai. 
         
         2)  Xenon---> Anesthetic
         
         3) Radon---> Ye to highly radioactive hoti hai----> Lekin, Radiation therapy me use hoti hai
         
         4) Krypton---> Lasers, Fluorescent bulbs, Flashbulbs me use hoti hai.   Iski lighe dense fog ko bhi penetrate kar deti hai, isliye, Krypton lamps ka use kiya jaata hai Airports par
         
         
         
         
                 
   
   Chloroplasts :   Ye Green color ke plastids hote hain, jinme kaafi jyada concentration me Chlorophyll present hota hai. 
    
                    Chlorophyll, light capture karta hai, or use useful energy me convert kar deta hai, jis se oxygen release hoti hai. 
                    
                    Chloroplasts, sab green plants or Algae me milte hain.      Animal cells me chloroplasts present nahi hote
                    
                    Chloroplasts ka khudka DNA hota hai---> Or ye khud reproduce kar sakte hai( Matlab, baaki podhe ki maa chud rahi ho, to bhi inhe koi chudai karne se nahi rok sakta). 
                    
                    Ye amino acids or lipids produce karte hain, jis se chloroplast membrane banai jaati hai. 
                    
                    They produce NADPH and molecular oxygen by phytolysis of water. 
   
                    Produced ATP by process of photosynthesis
                    
                    Green plants me Photosynthesis hota hai, Chloroplasts ke thylakoid membrane me. 
                    
                    
                    
   
   
   
   
   20 June, 2020 ko referedum to nahi hua, lekin ek Annular Solar eclipse jarur dekha gaya India ke kuch parts me
   
         1) Eclipse hota hai, jab moon, chutiyo ki tarah Earth or Sun ke beech aa jaata hai. 
         
         2) 3 tarah ke eclipse hote hain : 
         
              a) Annular Solar Eclipse : Moon, sun ko completely block nahi kar pata, lekin "Ring of Fire" type ka kuch chutiyaap ban jaata hai. ---> Badi disc ke upar, moon ki choti disc. 
              
                   i) New moon condition honi chahiye----> Moon is aligned between the Sun and the Earth----> Blocking the light received by the Earth from the sun. 
                   
                  ii) Moon, Lunar node ke kaafi pass hona chahiye, jis se Sun, Moon or Earth, teeno ek straight line me ho
                  
                 iii) Moon apni apogee yani, farthest from earth hona chahiye. 
                 
                 
              b) Total Solar Eclipse : Ye bhi tab hota hai, jab Moon, Earth or Sun teeno direct line me ho.    Ye bhi new Moon condition me hota hai.    
                 Lekin, ye bas thode se logo ko dikh pata hai, jo moon ki earth pe padne wali shadow ke bilkul centre me khade ho. 
    
   
              c) Partial Solar Eclipse : Sun ke thode se part par, Moon ki shadow dikhti hai.

        Plants ke vascular tissues hote hain Xylem and phloem ----> Ye water, Sugars and other important substance ko around a plant, transport karte hain.   In cheejo ko 'sap' kehte hain. 
        
        
           Xylem se---> Roots se stem or leaves tak, paani transport hota hai, or baaki dissolved compounds bhi. 
                        
                        Xylem se plant, hydrated rahta hai.      Xylem ko gravity ko counter karna padta hai, paani ko upar deliver karne ke liye. 
                        
                        Inme, One-way traffic hota hai. Matlab, paani bas neeche se upar jaata hai. 
                        
                          "Podhe ko pyaas lagta hai to wo bolta hai, Xylem-Xylem paani laao"--------> Xylem tu itna xulm na kar, mere diwane ko paani pila
                        
                        
           Phloem ----> Photosynthesis se jo food produce hota hai, unhe leaves se baai jagah pahonchaya jaata hai, jaha photosysnthesis nahi ho pata, such as roots and stem. 
  

                        Phloem jin cells se bana hota hai, unhe 'sieve-tube membere' ya 'companion cells' kaha jaata hai. 

                        Inme, 2 way traffic hota hai. 
                            "Podhe ko jab bhook lagti hai to wo bolta hai, Phloem-Phloem khana laao"

   India ka 3 stage nuclear Programme: 
   
   
     - Stage I : Pressurised Heavy Water Reactor (PHWR)
     
                 - Natural Uranium Oxide ka use kar bijli banana, jis se Plutonium-239 byproduct  milega. 
                 
                 - Moderator or coolant dono ka kaam karta hai heavy water. 
     
                 - Is puri tech par India is self-reliant. 
                 
                 
                 
     - Stage II : Fast Breeder Reactors ----> Second Stage of Nuclear power generation
     
                   - FBR wo reactors hote hain, jinme fast neutrons ka use kar, jitna fule consume kiya jata hai, us se jyada generate kar liya jata hai. 
                   
                   - 1st stage se jo Pu-239 mila tha, uska use karte hain. 
                   
                   - FBR ke fuel core me, U-238 ka ek blanket, core ke chaaro or hota hai, jo nuclear transmutaion se Fresh Pu-239 produce karta hai, jabki saath saath Pu-239 consume ho raha hota hai. 
                   
                   - FBR core me, thoda sa Th-232 bhi rakh dete hain, jo Neutron capture karta hai, or U-233 ban jata hai. 
                   
                   - Ye U-233, fir 3rd stage me use hoga. 
                   
                   - FRB ko Fast breeder isliye bolte hain, kyunki Moderator nahi use karta hai
                   
                   - Yaha coolant ke liye, Liquid Sodium use hota hai. 
                   
                   - India ka 1st prototype Fast Breeder Reactor ek, 500 MWe ka FBR hai, jise Kapakkam me Madras Atomic Power Station me banaya ja raha hai. 
                   
                   
      - Stage III : Advance Nuclear power system--> Self sustaining series of Thorium-232-Uranium-233 fuelled reactors hote hain. 
      
                    - 2nd Stage me jo U-233 obtained hota hai, use as a fuel use kiya jata hai. 
                    
                    - U-233 ke alawa, Th-232 ki ek blanket bhi hoga, U-233 reactor core ke arround, jis se reactor ke operational hone se U-233 milega. 
                    
                    - Matlab, more and more U-233 fuel will be produced from the Th-232 blanket as more of the U-233 in the fuel core is consumed----> Is se long term fuel requirement sustain ho payegi. 
                    
                    
                    
                    
                    
                    
                    
                    
      Chemoheterotrophs== Ye CO2 ki madad se organic compounds nahi bana paate bechare.     Inka carbon source hota hai--> Sufur, Carbohydrates, Lipids, Proteins. 
      
        Ex : Jyadatar Bacteria, Fungi, Protozoa----> Ye baki organisms par depend karte hain, survival ke liye. 
        
        
        
           Yeast, Mushroom, Bread mould ka bhi saprophytic mode of nutrition hota hai.    Ye digestive enzymes secrete karke, complex organic substances ko break down kar dete hain. 
           
           
           Phototrophs wo bhadwe organisms hote hain, jo photon capture se energy acquire karte hain.    Ye inorganic materials ko organic materials me convert kar dete hain----> Jinka use wo biosynthesis ya respiration jaise cellular functions me karte hain.               
                    
                                               
           Ek or tarah ke kitaanu bhi hote hain, jo Energy to lights se lete hain, or Carbon aaspass se jugaad lete hain---> Inhe Photoheterotrophs kehte hain----> Ex : Cyanobacteria

     Geostationary Orbit: 
     
         - Ise Geosynchronous equitorial orbit bhi kehte hain--> Circular orbit hoti hai, above earth's equator, or Earth ki rotation ki direction ko follow karti hai. 
         
         - Kyunki, Satellite hamesha ek hi position par rehti hai, isliye, normal se antenna ki madad se bhi Signal receive kiya ja sakta hai (Same as DTH, VSAT) . 
            
             (Parabolic antenna ka use, atmospheric distortions ko nullify karne ke liye kiya jata hai)
             
         - 0.25 seconds ka time delay hota hai, is liye, Voice calls ya video conferencing me use nahi kiya jata. 
         
         - Isliye, iska best use hota hai Time-Delayed services me, jaise ki direct TV ya Internet Data services. 
         
         - Ye stationary pratit hoti hai, ek point se.     Inhe bas Equator ke upar hi rakha jaa sakta hai, or inhe 35,790 km ke altitude par rakha jaata hai. 
     
         - THere is only 1 Geostationary orbit----> Yaha crowding ho rahi hai, or BC bhidne wali hain satellites aapas me.

    Types of Recoveries : 
    
      a) L-Shaped : Sharp decline with slow recovery
      
      b) U-Shape : "Nike Swoosh" relatively healthy rise
      
      c) W-SHape : Rise, Dips and then rises again. ---> "Double dip recession"
      
      d) V-Shape : Best case scenario
      
      e) Z-Shape : V-Se bhi badhiya recovery
      
      f) K-Shape : When different sections of economy recovers at starkly different rates.

        1)  Nature me Thorium jyada milta hai, Uranium se. ---->   Thorium Fertile hota hai, Fissile.   Matlab, koi Iraqi banda, reactor me irradiation se ise Fissile Material me convert nahi kar sakta. 
         
        2)  Ise, fuel ki tarah use karne ke liye, ise fissile material ke saath conjunction me daalna padta hai, jaise Recycled Plutonium. 
         
        3)  Thorium Fuels se, Fissile Uranium-233 breed kiya ja sakta hai----> Jise bohot tarah ke nuclear reactors me use kiya ja sakta hai. 
         
        4)  1 tonne thorium se, 35 tonne Uranium jitni energy banai jaa sakti hai, in a liquid fluoride thorium reactor---> Mu me lele Uranium, Thorium tera baap hai. 
         
        5)  Thorium based reactors safer bhi hote hain, kyunki reaction ko aasani se stop kiya jaa sakta hai, kyunki operations ko extreme pressures me nahi conduct kiya jaata. 
         
        6)  Ek to waste kam generate hota hai, dusra jo waste generate bhi hota hai, wo kam radioactive hota hai.

 Graphene:        
         
   - Graphene ek 2D alotrope hai, Carbon ka. Haan BC 2D. 
    
   - Carbon atoms, hexagonal design me positioned hote hain.      
         
   - Nanographenes banaye jaate hain, Hydrocarbons ki dehydrogenation karwaake. 
   
   - Graphene strongest known material hai,   Ye diamond se jyada hard hota hai,   Rubber se jyada elastic hota hai,  or steel se tougher hota hai, or Aluminium se lighter hota hai. 
   
   - Isme electron mobility, Silicon se 100 guna jyada tej hoti hai.    Ye diamond se 2 guna jyada heat conduct karta hai.      
   
   - Iski electricl conductivity, Copper se 13 guna jyada hoti hai.      
         
   - Or ye bas, 2% light absorb karta hai. 
   
        Uses: 
        
                   1) Energy storage and solar cells
                   
                   2) Sensor applications
                   
                   3) Graphene ink
                   
                   4) Transistors and memory
                   
                   5) Flexible, Stretchable and foldable electronics
                   
                   6) Photodetectors
                   
                   7) Coatings

         iii) Pillars, Doorways, Ceilings par decorated carvings ki jaati hai.

                           ii) Rashtrakutas---> Kailashnath Temple at Ellora

     Examples :- i) Doddabasappa Temple at Dambal    ii) Ladkhan Temple at Aihole    iii) Temples at Badami
     
     
     



  Dravidian Temple Phases
  
  
      i) Mahendra Group  :  1st Stage of Pallava temple .      Ye Basically rock cut temples the. 
      
                                                                Temples ko Mandap bulate the (Nagar Style me Mandap bas Assembly hall ko bulate the)
                                                                
    ii)  Narsimha Group  :  2nd Stage      Ye bhi Rock cut temples hi the, lekin inhe intricate sculptures se decorate kiya jane laga. 
    
                                           Mandap(Temple) ko separate Rathas me divide kiya jane laga.    
                                           
                                            Sabse bade rath ko Dharmaraj rath kehte the. 
                                            
                                             Sabse chote rath ko Draupadi rath.                                                         
 
                                           Dharmaraj rath ka jo design tha, wahi aage chalke Dravidian Style of Architecture ban gaya. 
                                           
                                           

     iii)  Rajsimha Group  : 3rd Stage      Rock-cut temple ki jagah, real structural temples ban na start ho gaye. 
     
     
                                            Ex :  i) Shore Temple at Mahabalipuram, Kailashnath Temple at Kanchipuram etc
                                            
                                            
                                            

        iv) Nandivarman Group  :  4th stage      Is stage jo temples bante the, wo chote size ke hote the.

   Polar Vortex : Ek low pressure area hota hai(kaafi wide), polar regions me, jaha thandi hawa chakkar kaat ti hain. 
   
                  Always exists near poles.    Summer me weak ho jata hai, Winter me takatwar. 
                  
                  "Vortex" bole to--> Counter-clockwise circulation of air, that helps keep colder air near the poles. 
                  
                  Strong vortex, thandi hawa ko poles par hi trap karke rakhta hai. 
                  Weak Vortex ke time, thandi hawayein, mid-latitudes(jaha burgers rehte hain) tak bhi pahonch jaati hai. 
                  
                  
                  Kabhi kabhi, Northern Hemisphere wala vortex jyada hi disturb ho jata hai(kyunki nort me irregular land and sea hai)
                  
   
   Ozone hole, dono poles pe banta hai====> Lekin, North wala hole, kaafi chota hota hai (Kyunki North pole pe warmer temperatures hote hain, south ke muqable). 
   
   Lekin BC, Vortex ka ozone se kya lena dena----?
   
   
       i) Winters me--> Vortex ke andar temperature goes below -78degrees----> Is se Polar Stratospheric Clouds ban ne lagte hain. 
       
           In clouds ke andar jo Ice particles hote hain, unpar, Ozone ki maa chod dene wale substances jaise CFCs, HCFCs, Bromine etc chipak jaate hain, or Stratosphere tak pahonch jaate hain. 
           
           Jab Summer aata hai, tab ye ice pighalti hai, or ye ODSs, Ozone ki maa chodna shuru kar dete hain. 
   
           Isliye, Summer aane par, Ozone holes badhne lagta hai. 
   
           Lekin jaise jaise garmi badhti hai, PSCs ka number kam hone lagta hai, or Ozone ki maa chudna bhi dheere dheere kam hone lagti hai, or December aate aate, Ozone firse recover ho jata hai. 
   
   
   
   
   
 
   
   Kul-Milake:   Strong Jet Stream---> Stable Polar Vortex----> Cold Air contained
   
                 Meandering Jet Streams----> Wavy POlar Vortex---> Cold air moves south and Warm air moves north.

Blue Hydrogen : Methane se banta hai; CO2 ko capture karke store kar dete hain. 

Green Hydrogen : Renewable Energy se banate hain, Isme koi CO2 release hi nahi hota

Brown Hydrogen : Ise COal se banate hain, CO2 emit hoti hai Atmosphere me (Burn the coal, pay the toal)

Grey Hydrogen :  Ye bhi Methane se banti hai, Lekin Blue Hydrogen walo ki jagah, yaha jo CO2 release hoti hai use store nahi karte balki, Environemnt me chor diya jaata hai. 

  
    Jo National Hydrogen Mission start hua hai-----> Usme Green Hydrogen banane ki baat ki ja rahi hai. 


  Hydrogen, Petrol wagarh se 2-3 times jyada efficient hoti hai. 
  
  Fuel Cells or Internal Combustion Engines, Sabme use kiya ja sakta hai-----> Isliye, Ye transportation ko transform kar sakta hai.  (Hydrogen Fuel cells ka Carbon Footprint to 0 hota hai)
  
  Wo RE jise store nahi kiya ja sakta, ya Grid me use nahi kiya ja sakta, Use Hydrogen Produce karne ke kaam me lagaya ja sakta hai.

        i) EU - Tricyclazole and Buprofezin etc use ho rahe the. Goro gi gaand fat ti hai inse.

      iii) Punjab ne to Triclazole or Buprofezin par ban hi laga diya, kharif 2020 ke time. 
       iv) APEDA ne basmati growing areas me awereness raise ki hai. 
        v) New Markets:- Timor-Leste, Puerto-Rico, Brazil, Yemen, Bhutan, Indonesia etc. 
       vi) Thailand or Vietnam ne pandameic ke wajah se exports rok diye. 
      vii) Agri export bill ne 2022 tak $ 60 Billion ke export ka target rakha hai.

 National Biofuel Policy ka target tha, 20% belending of ethanol in petrol and 5% blending of biodiseal in disel by 2030. 
 
 
     2003 me Min. of Petroleum and Natural Gas:- Ethanol Blending Programme 
     2014 me GOI leke aai, administered Price Mechanism

     2020 National Biofuel Coordination Committee :- Surplus rice jo FCI godowns me pade hain, unse Ethnol bana lo betich-d.
     2021 Interest Subvention Scheme :- Ethanol production capacity ko enhance or augment karne ke liye, ise extend karke Grain based distilleries tak extand kar diya, jo sorghum, sugarbeet se bana
                                        rahe the. 
     Ethanol Blend :- Blended motor fuel jisme 99% pure ethyl alcohol hota hai. 
                       Kyunki ye plant based hota hai, isliye ise Renewable fuel samjha jata hai. 
                       
                       
     Blending se fuel mixture oxygenated ho jata hai, isliye jyada ache se burn hota hai, or emissions kam hote hain.  Petrol ke comparrison me jyada octane number.  Kam CO emissions. 
     
     Biomass banane me CO2 absorb hoti hai, or biomas(corn/sugarcane) se bane biomass ko jalane me CO2 release hoti hai--- Offsets effect :- So it is Carbon Neutral. 
     
     
     India har saal, $ 551 billion ka oil import karte hain.   E20 programm se $4Billion tak bach sakte hain.

 Min of Jal Shakti ke under aane wale, National Hydrology Project(NHP) ne Glacial Lake atlas banaya hai. 
                                       -NHP ke under, water resource data ki quality improve ki jaa rahi hai. 
                                       -ISRO ka National Remote sensing Centre(NRSC), Hydrological studies conduct kar raha hai, using Satellite data and Geo-spatial Techniques. 
                                       -Resourcesat-2 satellite ki madad se, 0.25 ha se bade water spread wale glacial lakes ko map kiya ja raha hai. 
                                       
       Glaciers ke retreat karte time, glacial lakes form hote hain, moraine ya ice dams ke peeche ya.
       
       Ye weak hote hain, or easily breach ho jaate hian, floods wagarh ke time.  -----> Yahi hote hain, Glacial lakes outburst floods. 
       
       Abtak, 4700 se jyada lakes map kar li gayi hain.  Jyadatar area un lakes ka hai, jo 5 ha se badi hain.  Addhi se jyada lakes, 5000m se upar situated hain. 
                                                         Jyadatar are moraine dammed type lakes.   Kosi or Ghaghar basins me jyadatar, Glacial lakes hain. 
                                                         Yamuna Basin me minimum glacial lakes hain. 
                                                         Glacial Ice-dammed lake, bas ek hi hai, or wo hai Gandak basin me. 
                                                         
       BC, akele Uttrakhand me 93% of lakes hain. Or baaki Himachal Pradesh me. 
       
       Sabhi lakes ko 12 alpha numeric unqie ID di gayi hai.

     Meterological Drought: Kam baarish ki wajah se

     Flash Drought        : Aise droughts, jo bohot jaldi develop ho bohot rapidly develop ho jate hain.

 Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-Cell(CAR-T) therapy:- 
 
      T-Cells ko cancer cells se ladne pe majbor kiya jaata hai, Gene editing ki madad se. 
      
         T-Cells immune cells hoti hain, or scientist log, inhe patient ke blood se nikal ke, unme ek manmade receptor gene (CAR) insert kar dete hain. 
         CAR, se ye cells, fir cancer cells ke antigens ko better identify kar sakte hain. 
      
      Ye, ek tarah ka cell based gene edititng hai. 
      
      BIRAC or DBT ne milkar ye karnama kiya hai. 
 
 
 
 Gene Editing :
 
      3 stage complex process hoti hai :---- i) Unwinding ii) Cleaving and iii) Rewinding of DNA. 
 
                                                               Cleaving me, DNA ko cut paste kar edit kiya jata hai. 
                                                               
                                                               
                                                               
                                                               
                                                               
          Cut karne ke liye, 'Engineered nuclease' naam ka enzyme use kiya jata hai.     Ye ek specific site pe genome ko cut karta hai.  
          DNA jab cut ho jata hai, to cell apne aap use repair kar deti hai. 
          Isi repairing process ke time, editing ki ja sakti hai, us location par, jaha cut mara tha bc.
          
     Gene Editing Techniques:-
     
          i) CRISPR-Cas9
         ii) Zinc-Finger nuclease
        iii) Transcriptor activator-like effector nuclease(TALENs)

    Methane: Ye ek Short lived climate pollutant hai, jiski atmospheric lifespan, decades me hoti hai. 
 
                    Ye CO2 se kaafi kam time ke liye atmosphere me rehte hain, lekin kai hazar guna jyada garam kar sakte hain atmosphere ko. 
                    
                    Methane, ground level ozone formation me contribute karta hai. 
                    
                    Lekin, ise bhi ozone ki tarah, kaafi teji se hataya jaa sakta hai, due to short life span. 
 
 
                    CO2 ke baad, ye 2nd biggest contributor hai, climate change ka. 
                    
                    Ye saala to pandemic me bhi badh gaya, even though co2 ka level kam hua.

 Bond Yield:
 
    i) Bond agar, higher value pe trade kar raha ho, apni face value se, to ham kehte hain ki Bond is trading at a premium. 
       
           Is case me----> Bond ki yield, Coupon rate se kam ho jati hai. 
           
           
  ii)  Bond agar, apni face value se kam pe trade kar raha ho, to we say, Bond is trading at a discount. 
  
           Is case me-----> Bond ki yield, Coupon se jyada ho jati hai. 
           
           
           Kul milake---> As Bond Price Increase ===> Bond Yield Decrease
           
            
 
 
   Interest rates ka bhi Bond Yield pe affect padta hai.
   
       i) Agar Market rate, coupon rate se jyada hai---> To Investors will not find the bonds attractive====> Jis se Bond ka price decrease ho jayega----> Bond Yield Badh jayegi. 
       
      ii) Agar Market rate kam hai, coupon rate se to--> To Investor log ko James Bond kaafi attractive lagega===> Jis se Bond ke price badh jayenge-----> Bond Yield Kam ho jayegi. 
 
 
 
    
    
     Jab Bond Yields jyada hoti hai---> Tab Stock market kam sexy lagta hai. 
     
     
     Higher Bond Yields se Companies/Individuals ke liye Borrowing cost bhi badh jati hai. 
 
 
 
 
    US ke Bond Yields Badhne se Hamari Gand mar sakti hai:- 
    
       i) BY badhne se, US investors apna paisa, American market me hi rakhna pasand karnege---> Flow of Investment kam hoga. 
       
      ii) Rupee ke bhi wande ho jayenge. 
      
     iii) US ki BY badhne se, India ki  BY bhi chutiyo ki tarah dekha dekhi me badh sakti hai---> COmapnies ki borrowing cost badh jayegi. 
     
     
     
    BY badhne ke reasons: 
    
       i) Potential Recovery of US economy after Covid crisis. 
      ii) Tight Monetary policy---Rise in Inflation

Pradhan Mantri Van Dhan Yojana (PMVDY) is a retail marketing led value addition plan for Minor Forest Produce (MFP), meant for forest-based tribes to optimize the tribal income, locally. Under the program, MFP-based tribal groups / enterprises of around 300 members are formed for collection, value addition, packaging & marketing of Minor Forest Produces (MFPs).
These tribal enterprises will be in the form of Van Dhan SHGs which will be a group of 15-20 members and such 15 SHG groups will further be federated into a larger group of Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVKS) of around 300 members.

Ozone--Secondary pollutant---> When NOx and CO and VOCs react in lower atmosphere; Durring Sunny days; Dissipates during cooler nights........Ground Ozone + PM 2.5--> SMOG

CAFE regulations---Corporate Average Fuel efficiency. Rules in 2017--- CAFE under 130 gm/km till 2022. 



Maden-Julian Osscilation--> Band of low pressure areas(Bw 30N-30S) which moves from west to east; Detemines initiation and intensities of low-pressure areas/Depression/cyclones/Monsoons.
MJO influences the ENSO cycle. It does not cause El Nino or La Nina, but can contribute to the speed of development and intensity of El Nino and La Nina episodes.
When MJO is over the Indian Ocean during the Monsoon season, it generally brings good rainfall over the Indian subcontinent.



Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD)
o It is also referred to as the Indian Niño, is a condition when the SST of the western region of Indian Ocean alternately becomes abnormally colder and then abnormally hotter than the
eastern region.
o The Indian Niño can neutralise or worsen the impact of El Niño/La Niña depending on which phase it is in.
o A ‘positive’ IOD phase, which means higher-than-usual temperatures in the western Indian Ocean, brings more rain to India than the ‘neutral’ or ‘negative’ (cooling) phase.
